words.core_image: 手碰到烫的壶立刻缩回，动作在念头之前
examples: How did she react to the news?
Sodium reacts violently with water.
semantic_expansions: 反应（人）与起化学反应（物质）：都是'对来的东西反过来做出动作'，一个是行为一个是变化

words.root_logic: inter-（相互之间）+ act（做）→ 彼此对着做 → 互动
words.origin: 拉丁语 inter-（之间）+ agere（做）
words.native_definition: to act on each other, or to communicate with each other
words.core_concept: each doing something to the other – 双方各自对对方做出动作
words.core_image: 两只齿轮咬合，一个转另一个必跟着转
examples: Children learn by interacting with others.
The two drugs interact badly.
semantic_expansions: 互动（人）与相互作用（物）：都是'彼此对着做'，一个指交流一个指影响

words.root_logic: struct（堆叠、建造）+ -ure（名词）→ 堆叠起来形成的样子 → 结构
words.origin: 拉丁语 structura：struere（堆叠、建造）
words.native_definition: the way parts are arranged to form a whole, or a built thing
words.core_concept: how parts are stacked to hold together – 各部分怎样垒起来才立得住
words.core_image: 剖开的墙面露出里面的钢筋排布，哪根承重看得清
examples: The structure of the essay is clear.
A steel structure spans the river.
semantic_expansions: 结构/构造：各部分垒起来的方式
建筑物：垒起来的那个实体。同一个'堆叠而成'，一个说方式一个指成品

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ struct（堆叠）→ 把材料一起垒起来 → 建造
words.origin: 拉丁语 construere：com-（一起）+ struere（堆叠）
words.native_definition: to build something by putting parts together
words.core_concept: piling parts together into a whole – 把各部分垒到一起成为整体
words.core_image: 脚手架一层层往上搭，楼随之长高
examples: They constructed a bridge in six months.
He constructed a careful argument.
semantic_expansions: 建造（实物）与构建（论证）：都是把部件一层层垒成整体，一个垒砖一个垒理由

words.root_logic: de-（反向、拆除）+ struct（堆叠）+ -ive → 把垒好的拆掉的 → 破坏性的
words.origin: 拉丁语 destructivus：de-（拆除）+ struere（堆叠）
words.native_definition: causing great damage or ruin
words.core_concept: undoing what was piled up – 把垒好的东西反向拆掉
words.core_image: 拆迁球撞上墙面，砖一层层塌回地上
examples: The storm was highly destructive.
Such criticism is destructive rather than helpful.
semantic_expansions: 破坏性的与毁灭性的：都是'把垒起来的反向拆掉'——与 construct 共用词根，前缀 de- 与 con- 正好相反

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ struct（堆叠）→ 在对方脑中一层层垒起知识 → 教导；也指下达要照办的条目 → 指示
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ struct（堆叠）→ 在对方脑中一层层垒起来；也指交给对方照办的那些条目
words.origin: 拉丁语 instruere：in-（进入）+ struere（堆叠）
words.native_definition: to teach someone, or to tell someone officially what to do
words.core_concept: building knowledge into someone, layer by layer – 在人脑中一层层垒起东西
words.core_image: 师傅先讲地基再讲承重，学徒脑中的图一层层垒高
examples: He instructed the class in basic first aid.
We were instructed to wait outside.
semantic_expansions: 教导：在对方脑中垒起知识
指示/命令：把要照办的条目一条条摆给对方。同一个'一层层垒给对方'，垒的是知识还是要求

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ stru（堆叠、装配）+ -ment（物）→ 装配起来用于做事的那件东西 → 器具
words.origin: 拉丁语 instrumentum：instruere（装配、备置）
words.native_definition: a tool used for a particular purpose, or a device for making music
words.core_concept: a thing assembled in order to do work – 为做成某事而装配起来的那件东西
words.core_image: 打开的箱子里，每件工具嵌在自己的凹槽里
examples: Surgical instruments must be sterilised.
She plays three instruments.
semantic_expansions: 器具/仪器：为干活装配出来的东西
乐器：为奏乐装配出来的东西。同一个'为某用途装配的物件'

words.root_logic: instrument（器具）+ -al（…的）→ 起了器具作用的 → 起关键作用的
words.origin: 拉丁语 instrumentalis：instrumentum（器具）
words.native_definition: serving as the means by which something happens; also played by instruments only
words.core_concept: serving as the tool that made it happen – 作为促成此事的那件工具
words.core_image: 撬棍插进缝里一压，整块石板就起来了
examples: She was instrumental in setting up the fund.
The album is entirely instrumental.
semantic_expansions: 起关键作用的：本身充当了促成事情的工具
器乐的：只由乐器演奏的。两义都从'器具'来，一个抽象一个具体

words.root_logic: pre-（在…之前）+ dict（说）→ 事情发生前先说出来 → 预言
words.origin: 拉丁语 praedicere：prae-（在前）+ dicere（说）
words.native_definition: to say what will happen before it happens
words.core_concept: saying it before it occurs – 在事情发生之前先把它说出来
words.core_image: 天气图还没变，播报员已经说出明天会下雨
examples: Economists predict slower growth next year.
No one predicted the outcome.
semantic_expansions: 预言与预测：都是'在事情发生前先说出来'，中文按语体和依据分了两个词

words.root_logic: contra-（相反）+ dict（说）→ 说反过来的话 → 反驳；两说相互对立 → 矛盾
words.recall_hint: contra-（相反）+ dict（说）→ 说的话跟对方正相反；两边的说法也因此对不上
words.origin: 拉丁语 contradicere：contra-（相反）+ dicere（说）
words.native_definition: to say the opposite of what someone said, or to be inconsistent with it
words.core_concept: saying the opposite of what stands – 把话说到与既有说法相反的一面
words.core_image: 两份证词摆在一起，一份说在场一份说不在场
examples: He did not dare contradict his boss.
The two reports contradict each other.
semantic_expansions: 反驳：主动说出相反的话
矛盾/相悖：两种说法本身对立。同一个'说到反面'，一个是动作一个是状态

words.root_logic: dict（说）+ -ate（动词）→ 反复说出来让人照记 → 口述；说了对方就得照办 → 命令
words.recall_hint: dict（说）+ -ate → 一句句说出来让对方照着记；也指说出来对方就得照办
words.origin: 拉丁语 dictare：dicere（说）的反复形
words.native_definition: to speak words for someone to write down, or to give orders that must be obeyed
words.core_concept: saying words that others must take down or obey – 说出来，让对方照记或照办
words.core_image: 主管一句句念，秘书低头一句句记下
examples: She dictated the letter to her assistant.
Costs dictate how large the project can be.
semantic_expansions: 口述：说出来让人照记
命令/支配：说出来对方必须照办。同一个'说出即须遵从'，一个是文字一个是行为

words.root_logic: dictate（口述）+ -ion（名词）→ 口述这件事，或据此写下的练习 → 听写
words.origin: 拉丁语 dictatio：dictare（反复说）
words.native_definition: the act of speaking words for someone to write down, or an exercise in doing so
words.core_concept: words spoken to be written down – 被说出来供人记录的那些话
words.core_image: 老师念一句停一下，全班笔尖在纸上追着走
examples: We had a French dictation today.
The report was taken down from dictation.
semantic_expansions: 听写与口述：同一件事的两端——说的人在口述，记的人在听写
words.recall_hint: dictate（一句句说出来让人记）+ -ion → 这个过程本身，或据此做的练习

words.root_logic: ad-（朝向）+ dict（说、判给）→ 罗马法中被判归某人所有 → 离不开某物的人
words.recall_hint: ad-（朝向）+ dict（宣判、判给）→ 罗马法里被判归某人所有；引申为整个人被某物占去
words.origin: 拉丁语 addictus：ad-（朝向）+ dicere（宣告）——原指被判为债主所有的人
words.native_definition: a person who cannot stop using or doing something
words.core_concept: one adjudged over to something – 被判归某物所有、脱不开的人
words.core_image: 一个人被绳子系在某样东西上，走多远都被拉回去
examples: The clinic treats drug addicts.
He is a self-confessed coffee addict.
semantic_expansions: 成瘾者与沉迷者：都是'被判归某物所有、脱不开'，中文按程度分了两个词

words.root_logic: sci（知道、分辨）+ -ence（名词）→ 分辨得清的那套知识 → 科学
words.origin: 拉丁语 scientia：scire（知道）
words.native_definition: organized knowledge about the physical world, gained by observation and testing
words.core_concept: knowledge that can tell things apart reliably – 能可靠分辨真伪的那套知识
words.core_image: 两组样本并排做同样处理，只有一组变了色
examples: Science depends on repeatable results.
She teaches computer science.
semantic_expansions: 科学与学科：都是'能分辨清楚的成套知识'，一个指整体一个指分支

words.root_logic: science（分辨得清的知识）+ -ist（人）→ 从事这套知识的人 → 科学家
words.origin: 拉丁语 scientia（知识）+ -ist（从事者）
words.native_definition: a person who works in one of the sciences
words.core_concept: one who works at telling things apart reliably – 靠分辨真伪为业的人
words.core_image: 白大褂的人在记录本上对比两组读数
examples: Scientists have identified a new species.
She trained as a marine scientist.

words.root_logic: con-（一起、共同）+ sci（知道）→ 心里同时知道着 → 有意识的
words.origin: 拉丁语 conscius：com-（一起）+ scire（知道）
words.native_definition: awake and aware of what is happening, or deliberately noticing something
words.core_concept: holding knowledge of it at the same time – 同时知道着这件事
words.core_image: 麻药退了，人能听见旁边说话并知道自己在哪儿
examples: The patient was conscious throughout.
She made a conscious effort to slow down.
semantic_expansions: 有意识的：清醒并知道周围在发生什么
察觉到的：知道某件事存在
刻意的：明知而为之。三层都是'心里同时知道着'

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ sci（知道）+ -ence（名词）→ 心里同时知道对错的那份感觉 → 良心
words.origin: 拉丁语 conscientia：com-（一起）+ scire（知道）——'心中同知'
words.native_definition: the sense within a person of what is right and wrong
words.core_concept: the inner knowing of right from wrong – 心里同时知道对错的那份分辨
words.core_image: 没人看见，但自己心里那杆秤仍在偏向一边
examples: His conscience troubled him for years.
She acted with a clear conscience.
semantic_expansions: 良心与良知：都是'心里那份知道对错的分辨'，中文两种说法同一个内核

words.root_logic: conscience（心里知对错）+ -ous（…的）→ 事事按那份分辨来做的 → 尽责的
words.origin: 拉丁语 conscientiosus：conscientia（良心）
words.native_definition: taking care to do work thoroughly and correctly
words.core_concept: acting by that inner knowing every time – 每件事都照心里那份分辨去做
words.core_image: 没人检查的角落也擦干净了，因为自己知道那里脏
examples: She is a conscientious worker.
He was conscientious about checking every figure.
semantic_expansions: 尽责的与认真的：都是'每件事都按心里那份分辨去做'，中文按侧重分了两个词

words.root_logic: crit（判别）+ -ic（人）→ 做判别的人 → 评论家
words.origin: 希腊语 kritikos：krinein（判别）
words.native_definition: a person who judges the quality of works, or who points out faults
words.core_concept: one whose work is to judge quality – 以判别高下为职的人
words.core_image: 看完首演的人在本子上写下哪里好哪里不行
examples: The film won over the critics.
He is a harsh critic of the policy.
semantic_expansions: 评论家与批评者：都是'做判别的人'，一个是职业一个是立场

words.root_logic: crit（判别）+ -al（…的）→ 挑出问题的 → 批评的；也指到了必须判断的关口 → 关键的
words.recall_hint: crit（判别）+ -al → 惯于挑出问题；也指事情走到必须判断的那个关口
words.origin: 希腊语 kritikos：krinein（判别）
words.native_definition: expressing disapproval, or extremely important at a decisive moment
words.core_concept: at the point where judgement decides the outcome – 处在判断即定结果的那个点上
words.core_image: 病情走到今晚这个关口，往哪边偏就定了结局
examples: The report is highly critical of management.
The next few hours are critical.
semantic_expansions: 批评的：不断挑出问题
关键的/危急的：走到必须判断、判断即定结局的那个点。两义都从'判别'来，一个指行为一个指时刻

words.root_logic: critic（判别者）+ -ism（行为）→ 做判别这件事，及说出的话 → 批评
words.origin: 希腊语 kritikos：krinein（判别）
words.native_definition: the expression of disapproval, or careful analysis of a work
words.core_concept: the act of judging and saying so – 做出判别并把它说出来
words.core_image: 稿子退回来，页边密密麻麻写着哪里不成立
examples: The plan drew widespread criticism.
Her literary criticism is widely read.
semantic_expansions: 批评：指出问题的那些话
评论（学术）：细致分析作品的文章。同一个'判别并说出'，区别在是否含否定意味

words.root_logic: critic（判别者）+ -ize（使动）→ 去做判别、指出不足 → 批评
words.origin: 希腊语 kritikos：krinein（判别）
words.native_definition: to point out what is wrong with someone or something
words.core_concept: picking out what falls short – 把不够好的那部分挑出来指明
words.core_image: 把次品从传送带上一个个拣出来放到旁边
examples: She criticized the design for being impractical.
He was criticized for arriving late.
semantic_expansions: 批评与指责：都是'把不够好的挑出来指明'，中文按语气轻重分了两个词

words.root_logic: crit（判别）+ -erion（工具、依据）→ 用来判别的那把尺 → 标准
words.origin: 希腊语 kriterion：krinein（判别）——判别所依据之物
words.native_definition: a standard by which something is judged
words.core_concept: the measure against which judgement is made – 判别时所依据的那把尺
words.core_image: 桌上摆着一把量规，每个零件都要贴着它比一遍
examples: Price is not the only criterion.
Applicants must meet three criteria.
semantic_expansions: 标准与准则：都是'判别所依据的那把尺'，中文按适用范围分了两个词

words.root_logic: signum 本身即词根，无词缀 → 一个代表某物的记号；作动词是留下自己的记号
words.origin: 拉丁语 signum（记号、标志）
words.native_definition: a mark or object that stands for something; also to write one's name on something
words.core_concept: a mark that stands for something else – 一个替某物出面的记号
words.core_image: 路口立着一块牌子，牌子本身不是路，但告诉你路怎么走
examples: A road sign warned of falling rocks.
Please sign at the bottom of the page.
There is no sign of improvement yet.
semantic_expansions: 标志/迹象：替某物出面、让你知道它存在的那个记号
签名（动词）：把自己的记号留在纸上。同一个'记号'，一个是读它一个是留它

words.root_logic: sign（记号）+ -al（…的东西）→ 被发出来传递意思的记号 → 信号
words.origin: 拉丁语 signalis：signum（记号）
words.native_definition: a sound, movement, or transmission that carries information
words.core_concept: a mark sent out to be picked up – 被发送出去、供人接收的记号
words.core_image: 灯塔一明一暗，远处船上的人照着节奏读出意思
examples: The signal is weak in this valley.
She signalled for us to stop.
semantic_expansions: 信号：被发出去供人接收的记号
示意（动词）：用动作发出记号。同一个'发出记号'，一个是物一个是动作

words.root_logic: sign（记号）+ -ify（使成为）→ 使某物成为某意思的记号 → 表示
words.origin: 拉丁语 significare：signum（记号）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: to be a sign of something, or to make one's intention known
words.core_concept: serving as the mark for a meaning – 充当某个意思的记号
words.core_image: 旗子降到半杆，这个高度本身就在说一件事
examples: A red light signifies danger.
He nodded to signify agreement.
semantic_expansions: 表示与意味着：都是'充当某个意思的记号'，一个偏主动一个偏客观

words.root_logic: as-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ sign（记号）→ 在某物上标记归谁 → 分配
words.origin: 拉丁语 assignare：ad-（朝向）+ signare（做记号）
words.native_definition: to give a task or thing to a particular person
words.core_concept: marking something as belonging to someone – 标明这份归谁
words.core_image: 每个座位贴上一张写好名字的标签
examples: Each student was assigned a topic.
The case was assigned to a new judge.
semantic_expansions: 分配/指派/布置：都是'标明这一份归谁'，中文按对象分了三个词

words.root_logic: assign（标明归谁）+ -ment（结果）→ 被标到你名下的那件事 → 任务
words.origin: 拉丁语 assignare：ad-（朝向）+ signare（做记号）
words.native_definition: a task given to someone, or the act of giving it
words.core_concept: the piece marked as yours to do – 被标到你名下要做的那一份
words.core_image: 名单上你那一行后面写着要交的东西和日期
examples: The assignment is due on Monday.
She took an overseas assignment.
semantic_expansions: 任务/作业：被标到你名下要做的那一份
分配（行为）：做这个标记的动作本身

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ sign（记号）→ 先把记号画下来再动手 → 设计
words.origin: 拉丁语 designare：de-（往下）+ signare（做记号）
words.native_definition: a plan or drawing showing how something will be made, or to create such a plan
words.core_concept: marking it out on paper before making it – 动手之前先在纸上把记号画下来
words.core_image: 图纸上先画好每一道线，工人照着线施工
examples: The design won an award.
She designs bridges.
It happened by design, not by chance.
semantic_expansions: 设计/图样：动手前画下的那套记号
意图（by design）：事先画好的那个打算。同一个'先标记好再做'，一个是图一个是心里的图

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ sign（记号）+ -ate（动词）→ 明确标出是哪一个 → 指定
words.origin: 拉丁语 designare：de-（往下）+ signare（做记号）
words.native_definition: to name or mark something officially for a purpose
words.core_concept: putting the official mark on which one it is – 正式标出就是这一个
words.core_image: 地图上被圈起来涂色的那块地，牌子写着用途
examples: The area was designated a nature reserve.
He designated her as his successor.
semantic_expansions: 指定/划定/命名：都是'正式标出就是这一个'，中文按对象是人、地还是名分了三个词

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ sign（签署）→ 把签过的东西反签交回 → 辞职
words.origin: 拉丁语 resignare：re-（往回）+ signare（签署）——原意'解除签署'
words.native_definition: to give up a job or position formally, or to accept something unwelcome
words.core_concept: signing the position back over – 把签下的位置反手签还回去
words.core_image: 把工牌和钥匙推回桌面那一侧，签下最后一份文件
examples: She resigned after eight years.
He resigned himself to a long wait.
semantic_expansions: 辞职：把职位反签交回
顺从/放弃（resign oneself）：把自己交出去、不再抗。同一个'反手交还'，交的是职位还是自己

words.root_logic: re-（反复、坚决）+ quir（寻求）→ 反复索要，非有不可 → 需要
words.origin: 拉丁语 requirere：re-（反复）+ quaerere（寻求）
words.native_definition: to need something, or to demand it officially
words.core_concept: seeking something insistently, as a must – 反复索要，缺了不行
words.core_image: 报名窗口一遍遍问你要那张证明，没有就办不下去
examples: This job requires patience.
All visitors are required to sign in.
semantic_expansions: 需要：缺了不行，非有不可
要求/规定：正式反复索要。同一个'非要不可地索取'，一个说状态一个说行为

words.root_logic: require（非有不可地索要）+ -ment（结果）→ 被列出来非满足不可的那一条 → 要求
words.origin: 拉丁语 requirere：re-（反复）+ quaerere（寻求）
words.native_definition: something that is needed or demanded as a condition
words.core_concept: a condition that must be met – 一条必须满足的条件
words.core_image: 申请页上那几行打勾框，每一格不勾就提交不了
examples: Meeting the entry requirements is essential.
Sleep is a basic requirement.
semantic_expansions: 要求与必要条件：都是'非满足不可的那一条'，中文按语境分了两个词

words.root_logic: re-（反复）+ quest（寻求）→ 开口去求的那件事 → 请求
words.origin: 拉丁语 requirere → 古法语 requeste：re-（反复）+ quaerere（寻求）
words.native_definition: the act of politely asking for something, or the thing asked for
words.core_concept: an asking put to someone – 向对方提出的一次索求
words.core_image: 递过去一张写着所需事项的条子，等对方点头
examples: Your request has been approved.
She requested extra time.
semantic_expansions: 请求与要求：都是'向对方提出索求'，区别只在语气强弱——request 比 require 客气

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ quir（探求）+ -y（名词）→ 往里追问下去 → 询问、调查
words.origin: 拉丁语 inquirere：in-（进入）+ quaerere（寻求）
words.native_definition: an act of asking for information, or an official investigation
words.core_concept: seeking into something to find out – 往里追问，把情况问出来
words.core_image: 一间屋子里逐个叫人进来问话，笔录越积越厚
examples: We received several inquiries about the job.
A public inquiry was opened into the accident.
semantic_expansions: 询问：随口往里问一句
调查/探究：系统地往里追问到底。同一个'向内追问'，区别在规模与正式程度

words.root_logic: quest 是 quir 的变体，无前缀 → 长途去找一样东西这件事 → 探寻
words.origin: 拉丁语 quaesita：quaerere（寻求）的分词形
words.native_definition: a long search for something important
words.core_concept: a long search undertaken on purpose – 特意展开的一场长时间寻找
words.core_image: 背包上路，为找一样东西走了很远还没到头
examples: Their quest for clean water took years.
He set out on a quest for the truth.
semantic_expansions: 探寻与追求：都是'特意展开的长时间寻找'，一个偏具体目标一个偏抽象目标

words.root_logic: cor-（com- 的变体，完全）+ rect（使直）→ 已经被理直了的 → 正确的；作动词是把歪的理直 → 改正
words.recall_hint: cor-（完全）+ rect（使直）→ 已经被彻底理直了；作动词则是把歪的理回直
words.origin: 拉丁语 corrigere：com-（完全）+ regere（引导、使直）
words.native_definition: free from error; also to make something right
words.core_concept: brought into line with no deviation left – 被理到直，没有偏差留下
words.core_image: 歪掉的画框被扶正，与墙边线对齐了
examples: That is the correct answer.
Please correct any spelling errors.
semantic_expansions: 正确的：已经理直、无偏差
改正（动词）：把歪的理回直。同一个'理直'，一个是结果一个是动作

words.root_logic: di-（dis- 的变体，分开、朝某处）+ rect（使直）→ 一条直线通过去 → 直接的；作动词是把人引上直路 → 指导
words.recall_hint: di-（朝某处）+ rect（使直）→ 一条直线过去，不绕；作动词则是把人引上那条直路
words.origin: 拉丁语 dirigere：dis-（分开）+ regere（引导）
words.native_definition: going straight without detour; also to guide or manage
words.core_concept: along a straight line, without turning aside – 沿直线过去，不拐弯
words.core_image: 两点之间拉一条直线，中间不经过别处
examples: There is a direct flight to Osaka.
She directed the project for two years.
He directed us to the exit.
semantic_expansions: 直接的：走直线不绕
指导/导演：把人引上那条直路。同一个'使成直线'，一个说路径一个说带路

words.root_logic: direct（直线的）+ -ly（副词）→ 以直线方式 → 直接地
words.origin: 拉丁语 directus：dis-（分开）+ regere（引导）
words.native_definition: in a straight line or manner, without anything in between
words.core_concept: with nothing placed in between – 中间不隔任何东西
words.core_image: 话从这个人口中传到那个人耳里，中间没有第三人
examples: Report directly to the manager.
I will be there directly.
semantic_expansions: 直接地：中间不经过别人别物
立即：中间不隔时间。同一个'中间不隔'，一个隔的是空间一个是时间

words.root_logic: direct（引导）+ -or（人）→ 负责带路的人 → 主管、导演
words.origin: 拉丁语 director：dirigere（引导）
words.native_definition: a person who manages an organization or guides a film or play
words.core_concept: the one who keeps others on the line – 负责让众人走在那条线上的人
words.core_image: 片场上有人喊停，所有人等他说下一步怎么走
examples: She was appointed finance director.
The director asked for another take.
semantic_expansions: 主管/董事/导演：都是'负责让众人走在那条线上的人'，中文按场合分了三个词

words.root_logic: rect（使直）+ -ify（使成为）→ 使之变直 → 矫正
words.origin: 拉丁语 rectificare：rectus（直的）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: to put something right that was wrong
words.core_concept: making the crooked straight again – 把歪掉的重新弄直
words.core_image: 弯了的钢条被压回一条直线
examples: The error was rectified the next day.
Steps were taken to rectify the imbalance.
semantic_expansions: 矫正与纠正：都是'把歪掉的弄直'，中文按对象是物还是事分了两个词

words.root_logic: mov（移动）+ -ment（结果）→ 动这件事本身，或一群人一起动起来 → 运动
words.recall_hint: mov（移动）+ -ment → 动这件事本身；也指一群人朝同一方向动起来
words.origin: 拉丁语 movere（移动）
words.native_definition: a change of position, or a group of people working toward a shared goal
words.core_concept: the fact of something changing position – 位置发生改变这件事
words.core_image: 监控画面里草丛动了一下，别处都静着
examples: She noticed a movement behind the curtain.
The civil rights movement changed the law.
semantic_expansions: 移动：位置改变这件事
社会运动：一群人朝同一方向动起来。同一个'动'，一个是物理位移一个是集体行动

words.root_logic: mot（mov 的变体，动）+ -ion（名词）→ 动的状态；会议上被推出来待表决的那一项 → 动议
words.recall_hint: mot（动）+ -ion → 处在动的状态；也指会上被推出来等表决的那一项
words.origin: 拉丁语 motio：movere（移动）
words.native_definition: the state of moving, or a formal proposal put to a meeting
words.core_concept: being in the state of moving – 处在动着的状态
words.core_image: 钟摆一直左右晃，从没停在中间
examples: The laws of motion were set out by Newton.
The motion was carried by a wide margin.
semantic_expansions: 运动/动作：处在动着的状态
动议：在会上被推动起来的那一项提案。同一个'动'，一个是物理一个是程序

words.root_logic: mot（动）+ -ive（使…的）→ 使人动起来的那个东西 → 动机
words.origin: 拉丁语 motivus：movere（推动）
words.native_definition: the reason that makes someone act
words.core_concept: what sets a person in motion – 推着人动起来的那个缘由
words.core_image: 查案时找的不是脚印，而是他为什么要走这一趟
examples: Police could find no motive for the attack.
Profit was not her only motive.
semantic_expansions: 动机与目的：都是'推着人动起来的那个缘由'，一个偏内因一个偏所指

words.root_logic: mot（动）+ -or（施动器）→ 负责使东西动起来的那件装置 → 马达
words.origin: 拉丁语 motor：movere（推动）
words.native_definition: a machine that makes something move, especially using electricity
words.core_concept: the device that produces motion – 专门制造运动的那个器械
words.core_image: 接通电源，铁芯里的轴开始转，带着皮带一起走
examples: The motor burned out after ten years.
Motor vehicles are banned in the old town.
semantic_expansions: 马达/发动机：制造运动的那个装置
机动的（形容词）：靠这种装置驱动的。同一个'使动之物'，一个是物一个是属性

words.root_logic: re-（离开）+ mov（移动）+ -al（名词）→ 把某物移走这件事 → 移除
words.origin: 拉丁语 re-（离开）+ movere（移动）
words.native_definition: the act of taking something away from a place
words.core_concept: the act of moving something out of place – 把某物从原处移走这件事
words.core_image: 墙上取下画之后，留下一块颜色更深的方形
examples: Removal of the tumour took four hours.
The removal van arrives at eight.
semantic_expansions: 移除/拆除：把某物从原处移走
搬迁：把整份家当移到别处。同一个'移开'，区别只在移的是一件还是全部

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ vert（转）→ 整个翻转成另一种 → 转变
words.origin: 拉丁语 convertere：com-（完全）+ vertere（转）
words.native_definition: to change something into a different form, or to change one's belief
words.core_concept: turning something entirely into another form – 整个转成另一种形态
words.core_image: 阁楼加了窗和地板，从堆杂物的地方变成能住的房间
examples: The mill was converted into flats.
He converted to Buddhism in his forties.
semantic_expansions: 转变/改装：整体翻成另一种形态
皈依：把信仰整个翻过来。同一个'完全转过去'，转的是物还是立场

words.root_logic: di-（dis- 的变体，偏离）+ vert（转）→ 转到别的方向去 → 使转向
words.origin: 拉丁语 divertere：dis-（分开）+ vertere（转）
words.native_definition: to change the direction of something, or to draw attention elsewhere
words.core_concept: turning something onto a different path – 让某物转上另一条路
words.core_image: 路障立起来，车流被引向旁边那条巷子
examples: Traffic was diverted around the accident.
He tried to divert attention from the real issue.
semantic_expansions: 使转向/改道：让物流或车流转上别的路
转移注意：让注意力转向别处。同一个'转到别的方向'，转的是车还是心

words.root_logic: in-（向内、反过来）+ vert（转）→ 上下翻过来 → 倒置
words.origin: 拉丁语 invertere：in-（反）+ vertere（转）
words.native_definition: to turn something upside down or reverse its order
words.core_concept: turning something to its opposite orientation – 把某物翻到相反的朝向
words.core_image: 杯子倒扣在桌上，杯口朝下水流不出来
examples: Invert the tin to release the cake.
The usual order is inverted here.
semantic_expansions: 倒置/颠倒/反转：都是'翻到相反的朝向'，中文按对象是物、次序还是关系分了三个词

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ vers（转）+ -ation → 话头在双方之间来回转 → 交谈
words.origin: 拉丁语 conversatio：com-（一起）+ vertere（转）——原意'与人来往周旋'
words.native_definition: an informal talk between people
words.core_concept: talk turning back and forth between people – 话头在人与人之间来回转
words.core_image: 两人隔桌坐着，话一句来一句去，谁都没独占
examples: We had a long conversation about it.
She struck up a conversation with the driver.
semantic_expansions: 交谈与对话：都是'话头在双方之间来回转'，中文两种说法同一个画面

words.root_logic: ad-（朝向）+ vert（转）+ -ise → 把众人的注意转过来 → 做广告
words.origin: 拉丁语 advertere：ad-（朝向）+ vertere（转）——'使转向注意'
words.native_definition: to make something publicly known in order to sell it or attract people
words.core_concept: turning public attention toward something – 把众人的注意转到某物上
words.core_image: 街边竖起大牌子，路过的人一个个抬头看过来
examples: They advertised the post in two papers.
The company advertises heavily online.
semantic_expansions: 做广告/宣传：把众人注意转到自己这边
登招聘：把求职者的注意转过来。同一个'使注意转向'，转来的人目的不同

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ pel（推）→ 把人推出门外 → 驱逐、开除
words.origin: 拉丁语 expellere：ex-（向外）+ pellere（推）
words.native_definition: to force someone to leave a place or an organization
words.core_concept: pushing someone out of the boundary – 把人推到界线之外
words.core_image: 两名管理员架着人往大门外走，门在身后合上
examples: He was expelled from school at sixteen.
The engine expels hot gas.
semantic_expansions: 驱逐/开除（人）：把人推出这个范围
排出（气体）：把物质推出体外。同一个'往外推'，推的是人还是物

words.root_logic: com-（一起、彻底）+ pel（推）→ 一路推着对方走，没有余地 → 强迫
words.origin: 拉丁语 compellere：com-（一起）+ pellere（推）
words.native_definition: to force someone to do something
words.core_concept: pushing someone until there is no other option – 一直推着，直到对方无从选择
words.core_image: 背后有人一直推，前面只有一条路可走
examples: Illness compelled him to retire early.
Nothing can compel me to sign.
semantic_expansions: 强迫与迫使：都是'一路推到对方无从选择'，中文按主动被动分了两个词

words.root_logic: com-（彻底）+ puls（pel 的变体，推）+ -ory（…的）→ 被推着非做不可的 → 强制的
words.origin: 拉丁语 compulsorius：compellere（强迫）
words.native_definition: required by rule or law, not optional
words.core_concept: pushed on everyone with no opting out – 一律被推着做，不能选择不做
words.core_image: 校门口的名单上每一项都打了勾，没有留空的余地
examples: Attendance is compulsory.
Maths is a compulsory subject here.
semantic_expansions: 强制的与必修的：都是'被推着非做不可'，中文按场合分了两个词

words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ pel（推）→ 往前推 → 推进
words.origin: 拉丁语 propellere：pro-（向前）+ pellere（推）
words.native_definition: to push something forward, or to drive someone into a situation
words.core_concept: pushing something forward – 把某物往前推动
words.core_image: 螺旋桨在水里搅动，把整条船往前顶
examples: Jets are propelled by burning fuel.
The scandal propelled her into politics.
semantic_expansions: 推进与驱动：都是'把某物往前推'，一个偏物理一个可指处境

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ pel（推）→ 把靠近的东西推回去 → 排斥
words.origin: 拉丁语 repellere：re-（往回）+ pellere（推）
words.native_definition: to push something back or away, or to cause strong dislike
words.core_concept: pushing back what comes near – 把靠近的东西推回去
words.core_image: 两块磁铁同极相对，一靠近就被弹开
examples: This coating repels water.
The garrison repelled the attack.
His manner repelled her.
semantic_expansions: 排斥/击退：把靠近的推回去
使厌恶：把人的好感推回去。同一个'往回推'——与 attract（拉过来）正好构成一对

words.root_logic: pre-（预先）+ serv（守住）→ 提前动手守住，不让它坏 → 保存
words.origin: 拉丁语 praeservare：prae-（预先）+ servare（守护）
words.native_definition: to keep something in its original state, or to keep food from spoiling
words.core_concept: acting in advance to keep it from being lost – 提前动手，使它不至于失去
words.core_image: 果子趁新鲜就下了糖封罐，冬天开罐还是那个样子
examples: The treaty preserved peace for a decade.
Salt was used to preserve meat.
semantic_expansions: 保存/保护：提前动手使其不失去
腌制：用手段让食物不坏。同一个'预先守住'，守的是状态还是食物

words.root_logic: re-（往回、留着）+ serv（守住）→ 留着不动，专等某人某时 → 预留
words.recall_hint: re-（留着）+ serv（守住）→ 先扣下来不动，专等某人某时；也指人把话留着不说
words.origin: 拉丁语 reservare：re-（往回）+ servare（守护）
words.native_definition: to keep something for a particular person or purpose; also a store kept for later
words.core_concept: holding something back for later use – 扣下来不用，留给以后
words.core_image: 桌上立着一张小牌子，这一桌今晚谁都不能坐
examples: I reserved a table for four.
The bank holds large cash reserves.
She spoke with characteristic reserve.
semantic_expansions: 预留/储备：扣下来留给以后
拘谨（名词）：把自己的话和情绪留着不放出来。同一个'留着不动'，留的是位子还是自己

words.root_logic: reserve（留着）+ -ation（名词）→ 留下来的那一份，或心里留着没说的那点 → 预订、保留意见
words.recall_hint: reserve（扣下来留着）+ -ation → 被留下的那一份；也指心里留着没说出来的那一点
words.origin: 拉丁语 reservatio：re-（往回）+ servare（守护）
words.native_definition: an arrangement to keep something for you, or a doubt you keep to yourself
words.core_concept: what has been held back – 被留下、扣着没动的那一份
words.core_image: 订单页上你的名字后面跟着日期，那一格别人订不了
examples: I have a reservation under Chen.
She agreed, but with reservations.
semantic_expansions: 预订：为你留下的那一份
保留意见：心里留着没说出的那点疑虑
保护区：被划出来留着不开发的那块地。三义都是'扣着不动的那一份'

words.root_logic: con-（一起、彻底）+ serv（守住）+ -ation → 把整体守住不使流失 → 保护
words.origin: 拉丁语 conservatio：com-（一起）+ servare（守护）
words.native_definition: the protection of natural things, or the prevention of loss of energy or matter
words.core_concept: keeping the whole from being lost – 把整体守住，不让它流失
words.core_image: 围栏把整片林子圈起来，斧头进不去
examples: Wildlife conservation needs funding.
The law of conservation of energy holds here.
semantic_expansions: 保护（自然）：把整片守住不使受损
守恒（物理）：总量守着不增不减
节约（能源）：守着不浪费。三义共享'守住整体不使流失'

words.root_logic: cov（盖住）本身即词根，无前缀 → 在表面铺上一层，把下面挡住
words.origin: 拉丁语 cooperire：com-（完全）+ operire（盖）
words.native_definition: to put something over another thing, or to deal with a range of matters
words.core_concept: laying a layer over something – 在某物上铺一层，把它挡住
words.core_image: 一块布铺开落在家具上，轮廓还在但表面看不见了
examples: Snow covered the road by morning.
The course covers three centuries.
He tried to cover his mistake.
semantic_expansions: 覆盖：在表面铺上一层
掩盖：铺一层把不想被看见的挡住
涉及（范围）：像布一样铺满这一片。三义都是'铺一层盖住'

words.root_logic: dis-（去除）+ cov（盖）→ 把盖着的那层揭掉 → 发现
words.origin: 拉丁语 discooperire：dis-（去除）+ cooperire（盖住）
words.native_definition: to find something that was hidden or not known before
words.core_concept: removing the cover so it can be seen – 把盖着的那层拿掉，让它露出来
words.core_image: 掀开压了多年的一块石板，底下的字第一次见光
examples: Penicillin was discovered by accident.
We discovered that the account was empty.
semantic_expansions: 发现与查明：都是'把盖着的那层揭开使其露出'，一个偏偶然一个偏刻意

words.root_logic: discover（揭开）+ -y（名词）→ 揭开这件事，或揭开后见到的那个东西 → 发现
words.origin: 拉丁语 discooperire：dis-（去除）+ cooperire（盖住）
words.native_definition: the act of finding something, or the thing found
words.core_concept: the uncovering, or what was uncovered – 揭开这件事，或揭开后露出的那个
words.core_image: 考古坑边的牌子写着出土日期与器物名称
examples: The discovery changed the field.
Her discovery was published last year.
semantic_expansions: 发现（行为）与发现物：一个是揭开这件事，一个是揭开后露出的那个东西

words.root_logic: re-（重新）+ cov（盖）→ 重新把缺口盖上、补回原样 → 恢复、取回
words.recall_hint: re-（重新）+ cov（盖）→ 把破掉的地方重新盖起来、补回原样；也指把失去的拿回手里
words.origin: 拉丁语 recuperare / re-（重新）+ cooperire（盖）
words.native_definition: to return to a normal state, or to get something back
words.core_concept: closing back up what was opened or lost – 把破开或失去的重新补回原样
words.core_image: 伤口结痂后新皮长上，那一块又连成整片
examples: She recovered fully within a month.
Police recovered the stolen paintings.
semantic_expansions: 恢复/康复：把破开的重新盖合、回到原样
取回：把失去的重新收回手里。同一个'重新补回原状'

words.root_logic: recover（补回原样）+ -y（名词）→ 补回原样这件事 → 恢复
words.origin: 拉丁语 recuperare：re-（重新）+ capere / cooperire
words.native_definition: the process of returning to normal, or of getting something back
words.core_concept: the process of being restored to normal – 回到原样这个过程
words.core_image: 折线图从谷底一格格往上抬，慢慢回到原来那条水平线
examples: Economic recovery has been slow.
He made a full recovery after surgery.
semantic_expansions: 恢复/康复：回到原样的那个过程
回收（资源）：把散失的收回来。同一个'补回原状'，一个说状态一个说物

words.root_logic: un-（去除）+ cov（盖）→ 把盖的那层拿开 → 揭开
words.origin: 英语 un-（否定/去除）+ cover（盖住），词根仍是拉丁语 cooperire
words.native_definition: to remove a covering, or to reveal something hidden
words.core_concept: taking the covering off – 把盖着的那层拿开
words.core_image: 掀掉盖布，下面的机器露在灯光里
examples: Workers uncovered a mosaic floor.
Journalists uncovered the fraud.
semantic_expansions: 揭开（物）与揭露（事）：都是'把盖的那层拿开'，一个揭布一个揭内情

words.root_logic: flu（流）+ -ent（…的）→ 像水那样流出来不打结的 → 流利的
words.origin: 拉丁语 fluens：fluere（流动）
words.native_definition: able to speak or write easily and smoothly
words.core_concept: coming out in an unbroken stream – 出来时像水流一样不断不卡
words.core_image: 话从嘴里连成一条线出来，中间没有停顿去找词
examples: She is fluent in three languages.
His writing is clear and fluent.
semantic_expansions: 流利的与流畅的：都是'出来时不断不卡'，中文按对象是口语还是文字分了两个词

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ flu（流）+ -ence → 悄悄流进去起作用的那股力 → 影响
words.origin: 拉丁语 influentia：in-（进入）+ fluere（流动）——原指星体流泻下来的力
words.native_definition: the power to affect how someone or something develops
words.core_concept: something flowing in and shaping from within – 流进去、从内部起作用的那股力
words.core_image: 染料滴进水里，没有搅动但整杯颜色慢慢变了
examples: Her teacher had a lasting influence on her.
He used his influence to get the meeting.
semantic_expansions: 影响：流进去从内部改变了什么
影响力/势力：拥有这种能流进去的力量。同一个'流入而起作用'，一个说结果一个说能力

words.root_logic: influence（流入起作用）+ -ial（…的）→ 能流进去起作用的 → 有影响力的
words.origin: 拉丁语 influentia：in-（进入）+ fluere（流动）
words.native_definition: having the power to affect people or events
words.core_concept: able to flow in and shape things – 有能力流进去并改变什么
words.core_image: 他一句话说出去，几个部门的做法跟着变
examples: She is one of the most influential economists today.
The paper was highly influential.
semantic_expansions: 有影响力的与有势力的：都是'能流进去并改变什么'，一个偏思想一个偏权力

words.root_logic: af-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ flu（流）+ -ent → 财货朝这边源源流来的 → 富裕的
words.origin: 拉丁语 affluens：ad-（朝向）+ fluere（流动）——'流向此处而来'
words.native_definition: having plenty of money
words.core_concept: with wealth flowing steadily toward one – 财货源源不断流到这一侧
words.core_image: 几条水渠都朝同一个池子汇，池子始终是满的
examples: They live in an affluent suburb.
The country grew affluent after the reforms.
semantic_expansions: 富裕的与丰富的：都是'源源流来、始终不缺'，一个说钱财一个说资源

words.root_logic: super-（在上、超出）+ flu（流）+ -ous → 满到从边上溢出去的 → 多余的
words.origin: 拉丁语 superfluus：super-（在上）+ fluere（流动）——'漫过边沿而流'
words.native_definition: more than is needed, and therefore unnecessary
words.core_concept: flowing over the brim, beyond what is needed – 已经漫过边沿，超出所需
words.core_image: 水已经满到杯口还在倒，多的顺着桌面淌走
examples: Cut any superfluous detail from the report.
A second warning would be superfluous.
semantic_expansions: 多余的与过剩的：都是'漫过边沿、超出所需'，中文按语境分了两个词

words.root_logic: gener（生出）+ -ate（动词）→ 使某物生出来 → 产生
words.origin: 拉丁语 generare：genus（种、族）
words.native_definition: to produce something, especially power, income, or interest
words.core_concept: bringing something into being – 使某物从无到有地出现
words.core_image: 水轮一转，原本没有的电流出现在导线里
examples: The dam generates enough power for the city.
The ad generated hundreds of enquiries.
semantic_expansions: 产生/发电：使原本没有的东西出现
引起（反响）：使某种反应生出来。同一个'从无到有地生出'，生的是电还是回应

words.root_logic: generate（生出）+ -ion（名词）→ 同一批被生出来的人，或生出这件事 → 一代人
words.recall_hint: generate（生出）+ -ion → 同一时期被生出来的那一批；也指生产这件事本身
words.origin: 拉丁语 generatio：generare（生育）
words.native_definition: all the people born at about the same time, or the act of producing something
words.core_concept: one batch brought forth at the same stage – 同一阶段生出来的那一批
words.core_image: 全家合影里同辈的人站成一排，上下各是一排
examples: Her generation grew up without smartphones.
Power generation relies on coal here.
semantic_expansions: 一代人/世代：同一阶段被生出来的那一批
产生（发电）：生出这件事本身。同一个'生'，一个指所生之人一个指生的动作

words.root_logic: gener（种、类）+ -al（…的）→ 就整个类别而言的 → 总体的；统管全军的人 → 将军
words.recall_hint: gener（种、类）+ -al → 就整个类别而言，不针对个别；名词则指统管全体的那个人
words.origin: 拉丁语 generalis：genus（种、类）
words.native_definition: affecting all or most, not specific; also a high-ranking officer
words.core_concept: holding true for the whole kind – 对整个类别都成立，不限于个别
words.core_image: 通告贴在大门上，写的是全体，没有点名
examples: The general view is that costs will rise.
She was promoted to general last year.
semantic_expansions: 总体的/普遍的：就整个类别而言
将军：统管全体军队的那个人。同一个'管到整类'，一个说范围一个指人

words.root_logic: gener（出身、门第）+ -ous（…的）→ 原指出身高贵的，引申为出手大方的 → 慷慨的
words.origin: 拉丁语 generosus：genus（出身、家族）——原意'出身高贵的'
words.native_definition: willing to give more than is expected
words.core_concept: giving as one born to plenty would – 像不缺的人那样给出去，不计较
words.core_image: 分菜的人一勺压得满满，从不刮平勺沿
examples: He was generous with his time.
They served a generous portion.
semantic_expansions: 慷慨的/大方的：给出去不计较
丰盛的（分量）：给得远超所需。同一个'给得足'，一个说人一个说物

words.root_logic: de-（向下、脱离）+ gener（种、族）→ 脱离本来的种性往下走 → 退化
words.origin: 拉丁语 degenerare：de-（脱离）+ genus（种、族）
words.native_definition: to become worse in quality or condition
words.core_concept: falling away from the kind one came from – 从本来的种性上脱落下来
words.core_image: 野化多年的果树，果子一年比一年小而酸
examples: The debate degenerated into shouting.
Muscle tissue degenerates without use.
semantic_expansions: 退化（生理）/恶化（局势）/堕落（品行）：都是'从本来的样子往下脱落'，中文按领域分了三个词

words.root_logic: ap-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ plic（折）+ -ation → 把纸折好递上去 → 申请；把一物贴合到另一物上 → 应用
words.recall_hint: ap-（朝向）+ plic（折）+ -ation → 把折好的纸递上去；也指把一物贴合到另一物上使用
words.origin: 拉丁语 applicatio：ad-（朝向）+ plicare（折叠、贴附）
words.native_definition: a formal request, or the act of putting something to use
words.core_concept: folding one thing onto another – 把一样东西折过去贴到另一样上
words.core_image: 填好的表格折起来从窗口递进去
examples: Her application was accepted.
This has wide application in medicine.
semantic_expansions: 申请：把折好的文书递上去
应用/涂敷：把一物贴合到另一物上。同一个'折过去贴上'，贴的是纸还是用法

words.root_logic: ap-（朝向）+ plic（折、贴）+ -able（能…的）→ 能贴合上去的 → 适用的
words.origin: 拉丁语 applicare：ad-（朝向）+ plicare（折叠、贴附）
words.native_definition: relevant or able to be used in a particular case
words.core_concept: able to be folded onto this case – 能贴合到这个情形上
words.core_image: 模板往图纸上一按，边线正好对齐
examples: The rule is not applicable to part-time staff.
Delete whichever is not applicable.
semantic_expansions: 适用的与可应用的：都是'能贴合到这个情形上'，中文两种说法同一个动作

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ plic（折）+ -ate → 折了又折叠在一起 → 使复杂
words.origin: 拉丁语 complicare：com-（一起）+ plicare（折叠）
words.native_definition: to make something harder to deal with or understand
words.core_concept: folding layers together until hard to unpick – 层层折在一起，难以再摊开
words.core_image: 一根线绕了十几个结，想解得先找线头
examples: Do not complicate matters further.
His illness complicated the schedule.
semantic_expansions: 使复杂与使难办：都是'层层折叠在一起、难以摊开'，中文按侧重分了两个词

words.root_logic: complicate（折叠在一起）+ -ion → 叠上来的那道麻烦 → 复杂情况；病上添病 → 并发症
words.recall_hint: complicate（层层折叠）+ -ion → 又叠上来的那一层麻烦；医学上指原有问题上又叠一层
words.origin: 拉丁语 complicatio：com-（一起）+ plicare（折叠）
words.native_definition: something that makes a situation harder, or a secondary medical problem
words.core_concept: an extra layer folded onto the problem – 在原问题上又叠上来的一层
words.core_image: 本来只是一处骨折，术后又添了感染
examples: An unexpected complication delayed the deal.
The surgery went well with no complications.
semantic_expansions: 复杂情况/纠纷：又叠上来的那层麻烦
并发症：在原病之上又叠一层。同一个'多折了一层'，一个在事一个在病

words.root_logic: im-（向内）+ plic（折）+ -ation → 折进里面没摊开说的那层意思 → 含意
words.recall_hint: im-（向内）+ plic（折）+ -ation → 折在里面、没有摊开明说的那层；也指被卷进某事之中
words.origin: 拉丁语 implicatio：in-（向内）+ plicare（折叠）
words.native_definition: something suggested without being said directly, or involvement in something
words.core_concept: the layer folded inside, not spread out – 折在里面、没有摊开的那一层
words.core_image: 信里没写那句话，但读完就明白了那个意思
examples: The implication was that we should leave.
He denied any implication in the fraud.
semantic_expansions: 含意/暗示：折在里面没明说的那层意思
牵连：被折进这件事里面。同一个'折在里面'，一个是意思一个是人

words.root_logic: loc（地点）+ -ate（动词）→ 定出它在哪一点，或把它放到某点 → 找到、设于
words.recall_hint: loc（地点）+ -ate → 定出它在哪一点；也指把某物安置在某一点上
words.origin: 拉丁语 locare：locus（地点）
words.native_definition: to find where something is, or to put it in a particular place
words.core_concept: fixing which point something is at – 确定或指定它所在的那一点
words.core_image: 手指在地图上停住，就是这里
examples: Rescuers located the wreck at dawn.
The office is located near the station.
semantic_expansions: 找到/定位：确定它在哪一点
设于（被动）：被安置在某一点。同一个'定在某点'，一个是找一个是放

words.root_logic: locate（定点）+ -ion（名词）→ 被定下来的那一点 → 位置
words.origin: 拉丁语 locatio：locare（安置）← locus（地点）
words.native_definition: the place where something is, or a place used for filming
words.core_concept: the point at which something sits – 某物所在的那一点
words.core_image: 屏幕上一个蓝点标着此刻所在，周围是街道名
examples: Send me your location.
The film was shot on location in Iceland.
semantic_expansions: 位置/地点：某物所在的那一点
外景地：拍摄所选定的那个实地。同一个'定下的点'，用途不同

words.root_logic: loc（地点）+ -al（…的）→ 属于这一点的 → 当地的
words.origin: 拉丁语 localis：locus（地点）
words.native_definition: belonging to a particular small area, not the whole
words.core_concept: belonging to this one point, not everywhere – 只属于这一点，不涉及全局
words.core_image: 只有这条街停水，隔一条街的水龙头照旧出水
examples: Ask a local guide.
He was given a local anaesthetic.
semantic_expansions: 当地的：属于这一带
局部的（麻醉）：只作用于这一处。同一个'只限这一点'，一个在地理一个在身体

words.root_logic: local（属于这一点的）+ -ity（名词）→ 这一点连带周围的那一片 → 地区
words.origin: 拉丁语 localitas：locus（地点）
words.native_definition: a particular area or neighbourhood
words.core_concept: the small area around one point – 以某点为中心的那一小片
words.core_image: 地图上圈起来的一小块，圈里有几条街几家店
examples: Two schools serve the locality.
Rainfall varies by locality.
semantic_expansions: 地区与所在地：都是'以某点为中心的那一小片'，中文按视角分了两个词

words.root_logic: al-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ loc（地点）+ -ate → 给每份指定一个位置 → 分配
words.origin: 拉丁语 allocare：ad-（朝向）+ locus（地点）
words.native_definition: to give out shares of something for a particular purpose
words.core_concept: assigning each share to its own place – 给每一份指定它该去的位置
words.core_image: 预算表上每一行都填了数目，加起来正好是总额
examples: The council allocated funds for repairs.
Rooms are allocated on arrival.
semantic_expansions: 分配与拨给：都是'给每份指定它该去的位置'，中文按对象是资源还是款项分了两个词

words.root_logic: sequ（跟随）+ -ence（名词）→ 一个跟着一个排下来的那串 → 顺序
words.origin: 拉丁语 sequentia：sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: a set of things following one another in a particular order
words.core_concept: things following one after another – 一个接一个跟下来的那一串
words.core_image: 多米诺骨牌排成长龙，每一张都紧挨着前一张
examples: Follow the steps in sequence.
The film opens with a chase sequence.
semantic_expansions: 顺序/序列：一个跟一个排下来的那串
一连串（镜头）：连着来的那一段。同一个'前后相接'，一个说排列一个说片段

words.root_logic: con-（一起、随之）+ sequ（跟随）+ -ence → 随之跟来的那件事 → 后果
words.origin: 拉丁语 consequentia：com-（一起）+ sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: a result that follows from an action or condition
words.core_concept: what comes following on from something – 紧跟着某事而来的那个
words.core_image: 推倒第一张牌之后，后面整排跟着倒的那个局面
examples: He lost his job as a consequence.
It is a matter of little consequence.
semantic_expansions: 后果/结果：紧跟着来的那件事
重要性（of consequence）：能带来后续影响的分量。同一个'随之而来'，一个指事一个指分量

words.root_logic: consequent（随之跟来的）+ -ly（副词）→ 作为随之而来的结果 → 因此
words.origin: 拉丁语 consequens：com-（一起）+ sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: as a result of what was just mentioned
words.core_concept: following on as a result – 作为跟着来的那一步
words.core_image: 前一句话讲了原因，这一句就是它牵出来的那一步
examples: Sales fell; consequently, staff were cut.
He arrived late and consequently missed the vote.
semantic_expansions: 因此与结果：都是'作为跟着来的那一步'，中文一个作连词一个作名词

words.root_logic: sub-（在下、紧接）+ sequ（跟随）+ -ent → 紧接在后面的 → 随后的
words.origin: 拉丁语 subsequens：sub-（紧接）+ sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: coming after something in time
words.core_concept: coming next in time after – 时间上排在后面的那些
words.core_image: 日历上被划掉的那天之后的每一格
examples: Subsequent tests confirmed the result.
In subsequent years the town grew fast.
semantic_expansions: 随后的与后来的：都是'时间上排在后面'，中文两种说法同一个位置关系

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ secut（sequ 的变体，跟随）+ -ive → 一个紧跟一个不断开的 → 连续的
words.origin: 拉丁语 consecutivus：com-（一起）+ sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: following one after another without a break
words.core_concept: following without any gap between – 一个接一个，中间不断开
words.core_image: 考勤表上连着五格都打了勾，中间没有空格
examples: It rained for six consecutive days.
She won three consecutive titles.
semantic_expansions: 连续的与接连的：都是'一个紧跟一个、中间不断'，中文两种说法同一个内核

words.root_logic: ap-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ pet（追求）+ -ite → 朝着食物扑过去的那股劲 → 食欲
words.origin: 拉丁语 appetitus：ad-（朝向）+ petere（追求）
words.native_definition: a desire for food, or a strong wish for something
words.core_concept: the drive that pushes one toward something – 推着人朝某物扑过去的那股劲
words.core_image: 闻到饭香，脚已经朝厨房走了
examples: The medicine dulled his appetite.
There is little appetite for another war.
semantic_expansions: 食欲：朝食物扑过去的劲
欲望/兴趣：朝某样东西扑过去的劲。同一个'追着去要'，要的东西不同

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pet（追求）+ -ition → 几个人一起追同一样东西 → 竞争
words.origin: 拉丁语 competitio：com-（一起）+ petere（追求）
words.native_definition: the activity of trying to win or to do better than others
words.core_concept: several seeking the same thing at once – 几方同时追同一样东西
words.core_image: 一个位子几个人同时伸手，只有一只手能按上去
examples: Competition for places is fierce.
She entered a photography competition.
semantic_expansions: 竞争与比赛：都是'几方同追一样东西'，一个是状态一个是有组织的场合

words.root_logic: com-（一起、相称）+ pet（追求）+ -ent → 能力与所求相称的 → 有能力的
words.origin: 拉丁语 competens：com-（一起）+ petere（追求）——原意'相称、够格'
words.native_definition: having enough skill or knowledge to do something well
words.core_concept: matching up to what the task asks – 本事与所要求的相称、够得上
words.core_image: 岗位要求那一栏和本人条件那一栏逐条对得上
examples: She is a competent driver.
The court is not competent to rule on this.
semantic_expansions: 有能力的/胜任的/合格的：都是'本事与所求相称、够得上'，中文按场合分了三个词

words.root_logic: pet（索求）+ -ition（名词）→ 正式提出的索求，通常联名 → 请愿书
words.origin: 拉丁语 petitio：petere（索求）
words.native_definition: a formal written request, often signed by many people
words.core_concept: a formal asking put forward – 正式递上去的那份索求
words.core_image: 一张纸上密密麻麻签了几百个名字，递进办公室
examples: Ten thousand people signed the petition.
She petitioned the court for custody.
semantic_expansions: 请愿书/请求：正式递上去的索求
上诉：向法庭递上去的索求。同一个'正式提出所求'，递给谁不同

words.root_logic: re-（再一次）+ pet（追求、去取）+ -ition → 再去取一遍 → 重复
words.origin: 拉丁语 repetitio：re-（再）+ petere（追求、取）
words.native_definition: the act of doing or saying something again
words.core_concept: going after the same thing again – 同一样东西再去取一遍
words.core_image: 同一句话被念了第二遍、第三遍，字句没变
examples: Learning a language needs repetition.
Avoid needless repetition in your writing.
semantic_expansions: 重复与反复：都是'同一样东西再取一遍'，中文按次数感分了两个词

words.root_logic: texere 本身即词根，无词缀 → 字句像线一样编织成的那一整片
words.origin: 拉丁语 textus：texere（编织）——原意'编织成的东西'
words.native_definition: written words considered as a whole; also to send a message
words.core_concept: words woven into a continuous whole – 字句被编织成连成一片的整体
words.core_image: 一页字从头到尾连着读下来，像一整块布而非散线
examples: The text runs to sixty pages.
Text me when you land.
semantic_expansions: 文本/正文：字句编织成的那一整片
发短信（动词）：把字句编成一条发出去。同一个'编织字句'，一个是成品一个是动作

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ text（编织）→ 与这句话编在一起的周围部分 → 上下文
words.origin: 拉丁语 contextus：com-（一起）+ texere（编织）
words.native_definition: the words around a passage, or the situation in which something happens
words.core_concept: what is woven together with it – 与它编织在一起的那些周围部分
words.core_image: 把一句话从整块布上剪下来，边缘的线头就断了
examples: The quote makes sense only in context.
Judge the decision in its historical context.
semantic_expansions: 上下文/语境：与这句话编在一起的周围文字
背景（历史）：与这件事编在一起的周围情形。同一个'一起编织'，编的是文字还是情境

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ text（编织）→ 事先编好挡在前面的那套话 → 借口
words.origin: 拉丁语 praetextus：prae-（在前）+ texere（编织）——原指织在前面的花边
words.native_definition: a false reason given to hide the real one
words.core_concept: a story woven in front to cover the real reason – 事先编好、挡在真实原因前面的那套说法
words.core_image: 门前挂了一块织好的帘子，帘后的东西没人看见
examples: He left early on the pretext of illness.
The dispute was a pretext for invasion.
semantic_expansions: 借口与托辞：都是'事先编好挡在真实原因前的说法'，中文两种译法同一个内核

words.root_logic: text（编织）+ -ile（可…的东西）→ 织出来的那种材料 → 纺织品
words.origin: 拉丁语 textilis：texere（编织）
words.native_definition: any type of cloth, especially one that is woven
words.core_concept: material made by weaving – 靠编织做出来的那种材料
words.core_image: 布匹一卷卷立在架上，凑近能看见经纬线
examples: The textile industry employs thousands here.
These textiles are dyed by hand.
semantic_expansions: 纺织品与布料：都是'靠编织做出来的材料'，一个偏行业一个偏实物

words.root_logic: text（编织）+ -ure（名词）→ 编织的疏密所形成的手感 → 质地
words.origin: 拉丁语 textura：texere（编织）
words.native_definition: the way a surface feels, or the way parts are combined
words.core_concept: how the weave feels to the hand – 编织的疏密带来的那种手感
words.core_image: 手指从粗麻布上划过，能摸出一道道棱
examples: The cloth has a rough texture.
The dish had a creamy texture.
semantic_expansions: 质地/手感/纹理：都是'编织疏密带来的那种触感与纹路'，中文按侧重分了三个词

words.root_logic: curr（跑、流）+ -ent（正在…的）→ 正在流着的 → 当前的；名词则是流动本身 → 水流、电流
words.recall_hint: curr（跑、流）+ -ent → 正在流着的；名词则指那股流动本身
words.origin: 拉丁语 currens：currere（跑、流动）
words.native_definition: happening now; also a flow of water, air, or electricity
words.core_concept: the flow that is running right now – 此刻正在流的那一股
words.core_image: 河面漂着的叶子被水推着走，此刻在流的就是这一股
examples: The current issue is on sale now.
A strong current pulled the boat sideways.
Switch off the current before repairing.
semantic_expansions: 水流/电流：正在流动的那一股
当前的：正在流经此刻的。同一个'正在流'，一个是物一个是时间

words.root_logic: curr（流通）+ -ency（名词）→ 在市面上流通的那个东西 → 货币
words.origin: 拉丁语 currens：currere（跑、流动）——'流通之物'
words.native_definition: the money used in a country, or the state of being widely used
words.core_concept: what circulates from hand to hand – 在人手之间流通的那样东西
words.core_image: 同一张纸币今天在菜market，明天在药店，一直在换手
examples: The local currency lost value fast.
The term gained currency in the 1990s.
semantic_expansions: 货币：在人手之间流通的那样东西
通用/流通（gain currency）：一个说法开始在人群里流传。同一个'流通'，流的是钱还是说法
words.recall_hint: curr（跑、流通）+ -ency → 在人手之间不断换手流转的那样东西；也指一个说法开始在人群里流传

words.root_logic: oc-（ob- 的变体，朝着、迎面）+ cur（跑）→ 迎面跑过来 → 发生
words.origin: 拉丁语 occurrere：ob-（朝着）+ currere（跑）——'迎面跑来'
words.native_definition: to happen, or to come into someone's mind
words.core_concept: running up to meet you – 迎面跑到你面前来
words.core_image: 转过街角，一件事正好撞上来
examples: The accident occurred at midnight.
It never occurred to me to ask.
semantic_expansions: 发生/出现：一件事迎面跑到眼前
想到（occur to）：一个念头迎面跑进脑子。同一个'迎面跑来'，来的是事还是念头

words.root_logic: re-（再一次）+ cur（跑）→ 又跑回来一趟 → 再次发生
words.origin: 拉丁语 recurrere：re-（往回）+ currere（跑）
words.native_definition: to happen again, especially repeatedly
words.core_concept: running back around again – 又绕回来一趟
words.core_image: 同一个梦隔几天又回来一次，情节没变
examples: The problem recurs every winter.
The pain recurred after a month.
semantic_expansions: 再次发生/复发/反复出现：都是'又跑回来一趟'，中文按对象是事、病还是现象分了三个词

words.root_logic: in-（进入、朝里）+ cur（跑）→ 自己跑进那件麻烦里 → 招致
words.origin: 拉丁语 incurrere：in-（进入）+ currere（跑）——'跑进…之中'
words.native_definition: to bring something unpleasant upon oneself, such as cost or blame
words.core_concept: running into something and taking it on – 自己跑进去，把后果领回来
words.core_image: 明知有罚款还是超时停车，罚单就归自己了
examples: The firm incurred heavy losses.
You may incur a penalty for late filing.
semantic_expansions: 招致/承担/蒙受：都是'自己跑进去把后果领回来'，中文按语气分了三个词

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ curs（cur 的变体，跑）+ -ion → 往外跑一趟再回来 → 短途旅行
words.origin: 拉丁语 excursio：ex-（向外）+ currere（跑）
words.native_definition: a short trip made for pleasure, or a brief departure from a topic
words.core_concept: a run out and back again – 往外跑一趟，还要回来
words.core_image: 大巴早上开出城，天黑前又停回原来那个站台
examples: We took a day excursion to the coast.
Allow me a brief excursion into history.
semantic_expansions: 短途旅行/远足：往外跑一趟再回来
题外话：话题往外跑一段再拐回来。同一个'出去一趟还要回'，跑的是路还是话

words.root_logic: prob 本身即词根，无前缀 → 验过之后确认它站得住 → 证明
words.origin: 拉丁语 probare（检验、证实）
words.native_definition: to show that something is true, or to turn out to be a certain way
words.core_concept: putting it to the test and having it hold – 拿去验，验完站得住
words.core_image: 把梁架上重物，压了一天没弯，这才敢用
examples: The theory was later proved correct.
The plan proved too costly.
semantic_expansions: 证明/证实：验过确认它站得住
结果是（prove to be）：经过实际检验，显出是这样。同一个'验过见真'，一个是主动证一个是被验出

words.root_logic: ap-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ prov（验为好）→ 验过认为它好 → 批准
words.origin: 拉丁语 approbare：ad-（朝向）+ probare（检验、认可）
words.native_definition: to agree officially to something, or to think it is good
words.core_concept: having tested it and judged it good – 验过之后认定它可以
words.core_image: 文件上盖下那一枚章，往下就能办了
examples: The board approved the budget.
Her parents did not approve of the match.
semantic_expansions: 批准：验过认可，正式放行
赞成/认可：心里认定它好。同一个'验为好'，一个是程序一个是态度

words.root_logic: approve（验为好）+ -al（名词）→ 验过认可这件事 → 批准
words.origin: 拉丁语 approbare：ad-（朝向）+ probare（认可）
words.native_definition: official agreement, or a good opinion of someone
words.core_concept: the act of judging it good – 认定它可以这件事本身
words.core_image: 回执上写着已通过，日期和签名都在
examples: The plan needs council approval.
He looked at her with approval.
semantic_expansions: 批准：正式认可这件事
赞同/认可（目光）：心里认定它好。与 approve 同一内核，只是名词形式

words.root_logic: im-（进入、使…）+ prov（好）→ 使它变得更好 → 改进
words.origin: 拉丁语 in-（使…）+ probare（认为好）经古法语 emprouwer 进入英语
words.native_definition: to make something better, or to become better
words.core_concept: moving it toward the good – 把它往好的那一端推
words.core_image: 同一条路第二年铺了新面，走上去比去年稳
examples: We must improve response times.
Her health improved steadily.
semantic_expansions: 改进/改善：主动使它变好
好转：自己变好了。同一个'往好的一端去'，一个是及物一个是不及物

words.root_logic: improve（使变好）+ -ment（结果）→ 变好这件事，或变好的那一处 → 改进
words.origin: 拉丁语 in-（使…）+ probare（认为好）
words.native_definition: the act of getting better, or a change that makes something better
words.core_concept: the gain made toward the good – 朝好的一端所取得的那一段
words.core_image: 两张对比照并排贴着，后一张明显整齐些
examples: There has been a marked improvement.
The new model offers several improvements.
semantic_expansions: 改进/进步：往好的一端取得的那一段
改良之处：具体变好的那一点。同一个'所得的改善'，一个是抽象一个是具体

words.root_logic: minus（更小）的比较级形 minor → 两者相比更小的那个 → 次要的
words.origin: 拉丁语 minor：minus（更小）的比较级
words.native_definition: smaller or less important than others
words.core_concept: the smaller of the two being compared – 相比之下更小、更不重要的那个
words.core_image: 两处伤并排看，这一处不用缝针
examples: It was only a minor injury.
The film is not suitable for minors.
semantic_expansions: 次要的/轻微的：相比之下更小的那个
未成年人（名词）：年纪更小、还不算成人的那个。同一个'较小'，一个说程度一个指人

words.root_logic: minor（更小的）+ -ity（名词）→ 数目更小的那一部分 → 少数
words.origin: 拉丁语 minoritas：minor（更小）
words.native_definition: the smaller part of a group, especially fewer than half
words.core_concept: the smaller share of a group – 一群里数目更小的那部分
words.core_image: 举手表决时，这边举起来的手明显比那边少
examples: Only a minority opposed the plan.
The law protects ethnic minorities.
semantic_expansions: 少数/少数派：数目更小的那部分
少数民族：人口占更小份额的那个族群。同一个'较小的那份'，用在数量还是群体

words.root_logic: di-（往下、脱离）+ min（变小）+ -ish（动词）→ 一路变得更小 → 减少
words.origin: 拉丁语 diminuere：de-（往下）+ minuere（使变小）
words.native_definition: to become smaller or less important, or to make something so
words.core_concept: growing steadily smaller – 一路往更小的方向去
words.core_image: 余额一笔笔往下走，数字越来越短
examples: Supplies diminished over the winter.
Do not diminish her contribution.
semantic_expansions: 减少/缩小：数量或体积往更小去
贬低：把别人的分量说小。同一个'使变小'，小的是量还是评价

words.root_logic: min（更小、居下）+ -ister（人）→ 原指居下服事的人，后指受君主之命理政者 → 大臣、部长
words.recall_hint: min（居下、次一等）+ -ister → 原指居下服事的人；后来成为受命理政的那个职位
words.origin: 拉丁语 minister：minus（更小）——原意'仆从、下位者'
words.native_definition: a senior member of government, or a member of the clergy
words.core_concept: one who serves under an authority – 在上位者之下承事的人
words.core_image: 王座之下站着的人，命令由他去落实
examples: The finance minister resigned today.
The minister led the Sunday service.
semantic_expansions: 部长/大臣：受君主或政府之命承事的人
牧师：在神之下服事的人。同一个'居下承事'，服事的对象不同

words.root_logic: ad-（朝向）+ minister（承事者）→ 去为某事承担事务 → 管理
words.origin: 拉丁语 administrare：ad-（朝向）+ ministrare（服事）← minister（仆从）
words.native_definition: to manage the running of something, or to give out medicine or aid
words.core_concept: serving the running of something – 承担起某事的运转
words.core_image: 有人拿着名册逐项核对，每一环都得他签字
examples: A trust administers the fund.
Nurses administered the vaccine.
semantic_expansions: 管理/执行：承担某事的运转
施用（药物）：承担把它给到病人这件事。同一个'为之承事'，管的是机构还是给药

words.root_logic: poss（能够）+ -ible（可…的）→ 办得到的 → 可能的
words.origin: 拉丁语 possibilis：posse（能够）
words.native_definition: able to happen or be done
words.core_concept: within what can be done – 在办得到的范围之内
words.core_image: 门虽然紧，但用力推还是能推开
examples: Is it possible to change the date?
Come as early as possible.
semantic_expansions: 可能的与办得到的：都是'在能力所及范围之内'，中文一个说概率一个说可行性

words.root_logic: im-（否定）+ poss（能够）+ -ible → 办不到的 → 不可能的
words.origin: 拉丁语 impossibilis：in-（不）+ posse（能够）
words.native_definition: not able to happen or be done
words.core_concept: outside what can be done – 在办得到的范围之外
words.core_image: 门是砌死的墙，再用力也推不开
examples: It is impossible to please everyone.
He is being impossible about the details.
semantic_expansions: 不可能的：超出能力所及
难以忍受的（人）：让人无法应对。同一个'办不到'，一个说事一个说人

words.root_logic: possible（办得到的）+ -ity（名词）→ 办得到这件事，或办得到的那条路 → 可能性
words.origin: 拉丁语 possibilitas：posse（能够）
words.native_definition: the chance that something may happen, or an option available
words.core_concept: a way that lies within reach – 一条落在能力范围内的路
words.core_image: 岔路口有三个方向都走得通，随便挑一个
examples: There is a real possibility of rain.
We explored every possibility.
semantic_expansions: 可能性：办得到的程度
可能的事：具体那条走得通的路。同一个'落在能力之内'，一个是抽象一个是选项

words.root_logic: poss（有力、能支配）+ sess（坐、据）→ 坐在某物上、能支配它 → 拥有
words.recall_hint: poss（有力、能支配）+ sess（坐、据）→ 坐镇在某物上，它归你支配
words.origin: 拉丁语 possidere：potis（有力的）+ sedere（坐）——'坐镇其上'
words.native_definition: to have or own something, or to control someone's mind
words.core_concept: sitting over something as its master – 坐镇某物之上，由自己支配
words.core_image: 房产证上写着自己的名字，钥匙也在手里
examples: He possesses a rare talent.
She was possessed by a sudden fear.
semantic_expansions: 拥有/占有：坐镇其上、由自己支配
支配（情绪 possess）：某种情绪坐镇在人心上。同一个'坐镇支配'，主体从人变成情绪

words.root_logic: possess（坐镇支配）+ -ion（名词）→ 拥有这件事，或所拥有之物 → 财产
words.origin: 拉丁语 possessio：possidere（坐镇其上）
words.native_definition: the state of owning something, or a thing owned
words.core_concept: the holding, or what is held – 拥有这件事，或被拥有的那样东西
words.core_image: 搬家纸箱一只只摞着，箱上写着自己的名字
examples: The house came into her possession last year.
He lost all his possessions in the fire.
semantic_expansions: 拥有（状态）：坐镇支配这件事
财产/所有物：被坐镇支配的那些东西。同一个词根，一个指关系一个指物
words.recall_hint: possess（坐镇支配）+ -ion → 坐镇支配这件事本身，或被支配着的那些东西

words.root_logic: publicus 本身即词根，无词缀 → 属于众人的、摊在众人面前的
words.origin: 拉丁语 publicus ← populus（人民）
words.native_definition: open to everyone, or relating to people in general
words.core_concept: open to all, not kept to oneself – 对所有人敞开，不归私人
words.core_image: 公园大门没有门禁，谁都可以走进去坐下
examples: The park is open to the public.
She avoids public speaking.
semantic_expansions: 公共的：归众人所有
公开的：摊在众人面前
公众（名词）：众人本身。三义都从'属于众人'来

words.root_logic: publ（属于众人）+ -ish（动词）→ 使之进入众人视野 → 出版、发布
words.origin: 拉丁语 publicare（使公开）← publicus（属于民众的）
words.native_definition: to make something available to the public, especially in print
words.core_concept: putting something before everyone – 把某物摊到众人面前
words.core_image: 印好的书从仓库拉到书店，摆上开放的货架
examples: The journal publishes twice a year.
The findings were published last month.
semantic_expansions: 出版/发表：把作品摊到众人面前
公布（数据）：把信息摊开给众人。同一个'使进入众人视野'，摊开的东西不同

words.root_logic: publish（使公开）+ -ation（名词）→ 公开这件事，或公开出来的那份东西 → 出版物
words.origin: 拉丁语 publicatio：publicare（使公开）
words.native_definition: the act of publishing, or a book, magazine, or paper that is published
words.core_concept: the making public, or what was made public – 摊开这件事，或被摊开的那份东西
words.core_image: 架上一排期刊，每本封面都印着面世的日期
examples: Publication is scheduled for June.
The library subscribes to fifty publications.
semantic_expansions: 出版/公布（行为）：把东西摊到众人面前这件事
出版物：被摊开的那份东西本身。同一个词根，一个是动作一个是成品
words.recall_hint: publish（摊到众人面前）+ -ation → 摊开这件事本身，或被摊开的那份印刷物

words.root_logic: public（众人面前的）+ -ity（名词）→ 处在众人视野里的状态 → 曝光、宣传
words.origin: 拉丁语 publicus（属于民众的）
words.native_definition: public attention given to someone or something, or efforts to attract it
words.core_concept: being in everyone's view – 处在众人都看得见的位置上
words.core_image: 台上灯光打在一个人身上，台下几百双眼睛都朝那看
examples: The trial attracted huge publicity.
They hired a firm to handle publicity.
semantic_expansions: 曝光/知名度：处在众人视野里的状态
宣传：主动把自己推到那个位置上的工作。同一个'在众人眼前'，一个是状态一个是手段

words.root_logic: re（res 的变体，事物）+ public（属于众人）→ 众人之公事 → 共和国
words.recall_hint: re（res 事物）+ public（属于众人）→ 拉丁语 res publica'众人之公事'，指主权归众人的那种国
words.origin: 拉丁语 res publica：res（事物）+ publica（公共的）——'公共之事'
words.native_definition: a state in which power rests with the people and their elected representatives
words.core_concept: a state whose affairs belong to the people – 政事归属众人的那种国家
words.core_image: 议事厅里坐着各地选来的人，王座空着
examples: France has been a republic since 1870.
The republic was founded after the revolution.
semantic_expansions: 共和国与共和政体：都是'政事归属众人'，一个指国家一个指制度

words.root_logic: res（实在之物）+ -al（…的）→ 属于实在之物的 → 真实的
words.origin: 拉丁语 realis：res（事物、实在之物）
words.native_definition: actually existing, not imagined or false
words.core_concept: belonging to the world of actual things – 属于实际存在的那一类
words.core_image: 手伸过去能碰到，不是画上去的
examples: Is that a real diamond?
The real reason came out later.
semantic_expansions: 真实的/真正的/实际的：都是'属于实际存在之物'，中文按对比的对象分了三个词

words.root_logic: real（真实的）+ -ity（名词）→ 实际存在的那个状况 → 现实
words.origin: 拉丁语 realitas：res（实在之物）
words.native_definition: the way things actually are, as opposed to how they are imagined
words.core_concept: how things actually stand – 事情实际上的那个样子
words.core_image: 计划表挂在墙上，旁边是实际完成的进度条，两条不一样长
examples: The reality is harsher than the brochure.
In reality, few people read the terms.
semantic_expansions: 现实与实际情况：都是'事情实际上的样子'，中文一个偏整体一个偏具体

words.root_logic: real（真实的）+ -istic（…式的）→ 贴着实际来的 → 现实的、逼真的
words.recall_hint: real（实在的）+ -istic → 贴着实际来的：既指想法不脱离实际，也指画得像真的
words.origin: 拉丁语 realis：res（实在之物）
words.native_definition: sensible about what can actually be achieved, or looking very like the real thing
words.core_concept: keeping close to how things actually are – 紧贴事情实际的样子
words.core_image: 画上的水珠让人想去擦，几乎以为是真的
examples: Set a realistic deadline.
The model is remarkably realistic.
semantic_expansions: 现实的/务实的：想法紧贴实际，不脱离
逼真的：样子紧贴实物。同一个'贴着实际'，贴的是判断还是外形

words.root_logic: real（真实的）+ -ly（副词）→ 就实际情形而言 → 真正地
words.origin: 拉丁语 realis：res（实在之物）
words.native_definition: in fact; also used to add emphasis
words.core_concept: as things actually are – 按实际情形来说
words.core_image: 别人说的是一套，实际发生的是另一套
examples: What really happened that night?
It is really cold today.
semantic_expansions: 真正地/确实：按实际情形来说
很（加强语气）：由'确实如此'虚化成的程度副词。同一个'实在'，一个说事实一个只剩语气

words.root_logic: real（真实的）+ -ise（使成为）→ 使它成为实在的 → 实现；使自己看清实情 → 意识到
words.recall_hint: real（实在的）+ -ise → 使某物成为实在的；也指心里终于把实情看成实在的
words.origin: 拉丁语 realis：res（实在之物）
words.native_definition: to become aware of something, or to make something happen
words.core_concept: making something actual, in the world or in the mind – 使它成为实在的，在世上或在心里
words.core_image: 图纸上的房子盖起来了，站在门口才觉得它真的存在
examples: I did not realise how late it was.
She realised her ambition at forty.
semantic_expansions: 实现（计划）：使它在世上成为实在
意识到：使实情在心里成为实在
变现（资产）：使账面的东西成为实在的钱。三义共享'使成为实在'

words.root_logic: classis 本身即词根，无词缀 → 按某个标准分出来、彼此相当的那一组
words.recall_hint: classis 本身即词根 → 按某标准分出的、彼此相当的一组；可以是一群学生、一个社会层级或一个生物类别
words.origin: 拉丁语 classis（等级、编队）——罗马按财产把公民分级
words.native_definition: a group of similar things or people, or a group of students taught together
words.core_concept: a group sorted to one rank – 按某标准归到同一档的那一组
words.core_image: 学生按年级分进不同教室，同一间里的进度相当
examples: There are thirty students in my class.
The working class grew rapidly then.
Whales belong to a different class.
semantic_expansions: 班级/课：被分到同一档一起上课的那群人
阶级：社会里被分到同一档的人
类别（生物）：按标准归到同一档的物种。四义共享'归到同一档的一组'

words.root_logic: class（等级）+ -ic（…的）→ 属于最高那一档的 → 经典的
words.origin: 拉丁语 classicus：classis（等级）——原指'属于头等的'
words.native_definition: of the highest quality and lasting value, or typical of its kind
words.core_concept: belonging to the top rank, and staying there – 属于最高那一档，且一直站得住
words.core_image: 书架最上层那几本，每隔十年再版一次
examples: It is a classic example of overreach.
She reread the classics every winter.
semantic_expansions: 经典的/名著：属于最高一档且经久不衰
典型的：最能代表那一档的。同一个'归入头等/代表性那一档'，一个说价值一个说代表性

words.root_logic: classic（头等的）+ -al（…的）→ 属于古典时代那一档的 → 古典的
words.origin: 拉丁语 classicus：classis（等级）
words.native_definition: relating to ancient Greece and Rome, or to traditional forms in art and music
words.core_concept: belonging to the established old rank – 属于早已定型的那一档传统
words.core_image: 音乐厅里乐谱一律照两百年前的写法演奏
examples: She studied classical literature.
He prefers classical music to pop.
semantic_expansions: 古典的与传统的：都是'属于早已定型的那一档'，一个指古希腊罗马一个泛指旧规范

words.root_logic: class（等级、组）+ -ify（使成为）→ 把东西归进各自的组 → 分类
words.origin: 拉丁语 classis（等级）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: to arrange things into groups by their type
words.core_concept: putting each thing into its proper group – 把每样东西归进它该在的那一组
words.core_image: 标本一件件贴上标签，按科属放进对应的抽屉
examples: Books are classified by subject.
The file was classified as confidential.
semantic_expansions: 分类/归类：把东西归进各自该在的组
列为机密：把文件归进'不公开'那一档。同一个'归入某组'，组的性质不同

words.root_logic: classify（归类）+ -ation（名词）→ 归类这件事，或归好的那套体系 → 分类
words.origin: 拉丁语 classis（等级）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: the act of grouping things by type, or the system used
words.core_concept: the sorting, or the scheme it follows – 归类这件事，或所依据的那套体系
words.core_image: 墙上挂着一张树状表，从门到种一层层分下来
examples: The classification of species keeps changing.
Hotels are given a star classification.
semantic_expansions: 分类（行为）：把东西归组这件事
分类体系/等级：所依据的那套划分。同一个'归组'，一个是动作一个是体系

words.root_logic: com-（一起、完全）+ ple（填满）+ -ment（物）→ 把缺口填满使之完整的那部分 → 补足物
words.origin: 拉丁语 complementum：com-（完全）+ plere（填满）
words.native_definition: a thing that completes or goes well with another
words.core_concept: the part that fills what is missing – 把缺的那块补上、使之完整的部分
words.core_image: 拼图剩一个凹口，手里这块正好嵌进去
examples: The wine is a perfect complement to the dish.
The team has its full complement of staff.
semantic_expansions: 补足物/补充：把缺口填上使之完整的那部分
配套（人员齐备）：填满编制的那个数。同一个'补到满'，补的是搭配还是名额

words.root_logic: sup-（sub- 的变体，在下、额外）+ ple（填满）+ -ment → 在原有之外另添一份 → 补充物
words.recall_hint: sup-（额外、在下）+ ple（填满）+ -ment → 在原有的之外又添上的那一份
words.origin: 拉丁语 supplementum：sub-（在下）+ plere（填满）
words.native_definition: something added to improve or complete a thing, such as a vitamin or an extra section
words.core_concept: an extra portion added on top – 在原有之外额外添上的那一份
words.core_image: 报纸主刊之外另夹一叠副刊，抽掉主刊照样能读
examples: She takes an iron supplement.
The weekend supplement carries book reviews.
semantic_expansions: 补充物/膳食补剂：在原有之外额外添的那份
增刊：正刊之外额外附的那叠。同一个'额外添一份'——与 complement（补上缺口）的区别：complement 是补齐，supplement 是外加

words.root_logic: im-（进入）+ ple（填满）+ -ment → 把计划填进现实、填到满 → 实施；名词指用来填补活计的家伙 → 工具
words.recall_hint: im-（进入）+ ple（填满）+ -ment → 把计划填进现实里去做满；名词则指用来干这活的家伙
words.origin: 拉丁语 implementum：in-（进入）+ plere（填满）
words.native_definition: to carry out a plan; also a tool used for a job
words.core_concept: filling a plan into actual practice – 把计划填进现实，一项项做满
words.core_image: 计划表上的空格被逐条填上完成日期
examples: The rules take effect once implemented.
Farm implements hung along the wall.
semantic_expansions: 实施/执行：把计划填进现实做满
工具（名词）：用来把活干满的那件家伙。同一个'填满、做足'，一个是动作一个是所用之物

words.root_logic: multi-（多）+ ple（折叠、层）→ 叠了很多层的 → 多重的
words.origin: 拉丁语 multiplex：multi-（多）+ plicare / plere（折叠、充满）
words.native_definition: having or involving many parts or instances
words.core_concept: made of many layers or instances – 由很多层或很多份构成
words.core_image: 一叠复写纸，一笔下去底下每层都留了字
examples: He suffered multiple injuries.
Twelve is a multiple of three.
semantic_expansions: 多重的/多个的：由很多层或份构成
倍数（名词）：某数叠了整数次的结果。同一个'叠很多层'，一个说构成一个说数量关系

words.root_logic: tri-（三）+ ple（层）→ 叠了三层的 → 三倍的
words.origin: 拉丁语 triplus：tri-（三）+ plus / plere（层、充满）
words.native_definition: having three parts, or three times as much
words.core_concept: folded into three – 叠成三层、是原来的三倍
words.core_image: 三层玻璃窗，外面的声音一层层被挡下来
examples: Profits tripled in two years.
The door has a triple lock.
semantic_expansions: 三倍的/三重的：叠成三层
增至三倍（动词）：使它叠成三层。同一个'三层'，一个是状态一个是动作

words.root_logic: organon 本身即词根，无词缀 → 各司其职的那个部件：体内的器官、机构中的机关、乃至风琴
words.recall_hint: organon 本身即词根 → 各司其职的那个部件：体内的、机构里的，或那件靠许多管子各司其职的乐器
words.origin: 希腊语 organon（器具、工作部件）
words.native_definition: a part of the body with a special function; also an institution or a musical instrument
words.core_concept: a part that performs its own function – 承担自己那一份职能的部件
words.core_image: 解剖图上每一块都标着它负责什么，谁也不替谁
examples: The liver is a vital organ.
The paper was the official organ of the party.
She plays the church organ.
semantic_expansions: 器官：体内各司其职的部件
机关：体制里各司其职的单位
风琴：由许多管子各司其职发声的乐器。三义共享'各管一份职能的部件'

words.root_logic: organ（有机部件）+ -ic（…的）→ 由活体部件构成的 → 有机的；引申为自己长成而非人工拼装的 → 自然生成的
words.recall_hint: organ（各司其职的活体部件）+ -ic → 由活体部件构成的；引申为自己长成而非人工拼装
words.origin: 希腊语 organikos：organon（器具、部件）
words.native_definition: relating to living matter, produced without artificial chemicals, or developing naturally
words.core_concept: made of living parts, growing of itself – 由活的部件构成，自己长成
words.core_image: 地里的菜自己长出来，没有喷过药
examples: They only buy organic vegetables.
The town grew in an organic way.
semantic_expansions: 有机的/器官的：由活的部件构成
自然生成的：不靠外力硬凑、自己长成。同一个'活体部件'，一个说成分一个说生长方式

words.root_logic: organ（部件）+ -ism（体系）→ 各部件配合成的一个活体 → 生物体
words.origin: 希腊语 organon（部件）+ -ism（体系）
words.native_definition: any living thing, or a whole made of interdependent parts
words.core_concept: a whole in which parts work together to live – 各部件相互依赖、合成一个活体
words.core_image: 一只草履虫在水滴里游，它整个就是一套自洽的系统
examples: Bacteria are single-celled organisms.
A city behaves like a living organism.
semantic_expansions: 生物体与有机体：都是'各部件相互依赖合成的活体'，一个偏生物学一个可喻指组织

words.root_logic: organ（各司其职的部件）+ -ize（使成为）→ 让各部分各就各位地配合 → 组织
words.origin: 希腊语 organon（部件）+ -ize（使成为）
words.native_definition: to arrange things or people so that they work together properly
words.core_concept: setting parts in their places so they work as one – 让各部分各就各位、配合成一体
words.core_image: 散乱的工具按用途摆进格子，一伸手就知道拿哪件
examples: She organized the whole conference.
Organize your notes before the exam.
semantic_expansions: 组织（活动）/安排：让各部分各就各位地配合
整理（笔记）：让内容各归其位。同一个'各就各位'，对象是人还是物

words.root_logic: organize（各就各位）+ -ation（名词）→ 各部分配合起来的那个整体，或配合这件事 → 组织
words.recall_hint: organize（让各部分各就各位）+ -ation → 配合起来的那个整体，或配合这件事本身
words.origin: 希腊语 organon（部件）+ -ation
words.native_definition: a structured group of people working together, or the act of arranging something
words.core_concept: the whole formed by parts working together – 各部分配合而成的那个整体
words.core_image: 架构图上一格连一格，每格写着谁管什么
examples: She works for a charitable organization.
The organization of the event took months.
semantic_expansions: 组织/机构：各部分配合而成的那个整体
编排（行为）：让各部分配合这件事。同一个词根，一个指实体一个指动作

words.root_logic: ponere（放置）本身即词根，无前缀 → 把身体或问题摆到某个位置上
words.recall_hint: ponere（放置）本身即词根 → 把某样东西摆到位置上：可以是身体的姿势，也可以是抛给别人的难题
words.origin: 拉丁语 ponere（放置）经古法语 poser 进入英语
words.native_definition: to hold a position for a picture, or to present a problem or question
words.core_concept: placing something into position – 把某物摆到一个位置上
words.core_image: 摄影师说别动，人就停在那个姿势上不再改
examples: She posed for the portrait.
The leak poses a serious risk.
He posed an awkward question.
semantic_expansions: 摆姿势：把身体摆到某个位置
造成（风险）/提出（问题）：把一件事摆到别人面前。同一个'摆到位置上'，摆的是身体还是问题

words.root_logic: op-（ob- 的变体，对着）+ pon（放置）+ -ent（人）→ 被摆在你对面的那个人 → 对手
words.origin: 拉丁语 opponens：ob-（对着）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: a person who competes against or argues against another
words.core_concept: the one placed facing you – 被摆在你正对面的那个人
words.core_image: 棋盘两侧各坐一人，中间隔着盘面对视
examples: She defeated her opponent in three sets.
He is a longtime opponent of the tax.
semantic_expansions: 对手（比赛）与反对者（立场）：都是'被摆在你对面的那个人'，一个在场上一个在议题上

words.root_logic: op-（对着）+ posit（放置）→ 被摆在正对面的 → 相对的、相反的
words.origin: 拉丁语 oppositus：ob-（对着）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: facing something directly, or completely different from it
words.core_concept: placed directly facing, hence contrary – 摆在正对面，因而相反
words.core_image: 街两侧的两家店门对门，谁都看得见谁
examples: They sat at opposite ends of the table.
The result was the opposite of what we hoped.
semantic_expansions: 相对的/对面：位置上正对着
相反的：性质上正对着。同一个'摆在正对面'，一个说空间一个说性质
words.recall_hint: op-（对着）+ posit（放置）→ 摆在正对面的：既指位置上面对面，也指性质上正相左

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pon（放置）+ -ent（物）→ 被放在一起构成整体的那一件 → 部件
words.origin: 拉丁语 componens：com-（一起）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: one of the parts that together make up a whole
words.core_concept: one piece placed together with others – 与别的一起放着、共同构成整体的那一件
words.core_image: 拆开的收音机零件摊在布上，每件都是整机的一部分
examples: Each component is tested separately.
Trust is a key component of teamwork.
semantic_expansions: 部件与组成部分：都是'与别的一起放着、共同构成整体的那一件'，一个偏实物一个可抽象

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ posit（放置）+ -e → 由几样东西放在一起做成的 → 合成的
words.origin: 拉丁语 compositus：com-（一起）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: made up of several different parts or materials
words.core_concept: made by placing several things together – 由几样东西合放在一起做成
words.core_image: 碳纤维板一层层压合，成品比任何单层都硬
examples: The wing is made of composite materials.
Police released a composite sketch.
semantic_expansions: 合成的/复合的：由几样放在一起做成
合成物（名词）：那个做成的东西。同一个'合放而成'，一个说属性一个指物

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pound（pon 的变体，放置）→ 放在一起结合成的那个 → 化合物；作动词是使问题叠加 → 加重
words.recall_hint: com-（一起）+ pound（pon 放置）→ 几样东西放在一起结合成的那个；作动词则是又叠上一层使之加重
words.origin: 拉丁语 componere：com-（一起）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: a substance formed from two or more elements; also to make something worse
words.core_concept: things put together into one – 几样东西放在一起结合成一个
words.core_image: 两种粉末混合后加热，出来的东西两者都不像
examples: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
Delays compounded the problem.
semantic_expansions: 化合物/复合词：几样放在一起结合成的那个
加重（动词）：又叠上一层使之更糟。同一个'放在一起'，一个是结合一个是叠加

words.root_logic: dispose（分开安置）+ -al（名词）→ 把东西安置走这件事 → 处理；也指可供支配的状态 → 任由处置
words.recall_hint: dispose（分开安置）+ -al → 把东西安置走这件事；也指某物归你支配、任你安置
words.origin: 拉丁语 disponere：dis-（分开）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: the act of getting rid of something, or the power to use it as one wishes
words.core_concept: placing something away, or having it at one's placing – 把东西安置走，或由你来安置
words.core_image: 垃圾被拖到指定的地方倒掉，从此不在这里
examples: Waste disposal costs have risen.
I put the car at your disposal.
semantic_expansions: 处理/清除：把东西安置到别处去
任意支配（at one's disposal）：由你来决定怎么安置。同一个'安置'，一个是动作一个是权限

words.root_logic: dispose（分开安置）+ -ition（名词）→ 各部分被安置成的那个格局；引申为一个人心性的那副格局 → 性情
words.recall_hint: dispose（分开安置）+ -ition → 各部分被安置成的那个格局；用在人身上则是心性的那副底子
words.origin: 拉丁语 dispositio：dis-（分开）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: a person's natural qualities of mind, or the way things are arranged
words.core_concept: how the parts have been set out – 各部分被安置成的那个格局
words.core_image: 棋子在盘上摆开的那个局面，看一眼就知道谁占优
examples: She has a cheerful disposition.
The disposition of troops was kept secret.
semantic_expansions: 布置：各部分被安置成的格局
性情/倾向：一个人心性被安置成的那副格局。同一个'摆开的格局'，一个在物一个在人

words.root_logic: expose（放到外面）+ -ure（名词）→ 被放在外面无遮挡的那个状态 → 暴露
words.recall_hint: expose（放到外面）+ -ure → 被搁在外面、没有遮挡的那个状态；也指被公众看见，或底片见光的那一下
words.origin: 拉丁语 exponere：ex-（向外）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: the state of being unprotected, or of being made known; also the act of letting light onto film
words.core_concept: being left out in the open – 被搁在外面、没有遮挡
words.core_image: 帐篷被风掀走，人整夜坐在没有遮挡的山坡上
examples: Prolonged exposure to sun damages skin.
The scandal received wide exposure.
The photo needs a longer exposure.
semantic_expansions: 暴露/接触：被搁在外面直接受影响
曝光（新闻/摄影）：被放到众人或光线之下。三义共享'放在外面无遮挡'

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ posit（放置）+ -ion → 被放在名词前面的那个词 → 介词
words.origin: 拉丁语 praepositio：prae-（在前）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: a word placed before a noun to show relation, such as in, on, or by
words.core_concept: a word placed in front of a noun – 被摆在名词前面的那个词
words.core_image: 句子里那个小词紧贴在名词前，指出谁在谁上面
examples: In English, prepositions often follow the verb.
Do not end the clause with a preposition.

words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ posit（放置）+ -ion → 被推到前面待议的那个说法 → 命题、提议
words.origin: 拉丁语 propositio：pro-（向前）+ ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: a statement put forward for discussion, or a business offer
words.core_concept: a statement placed forward to be judged – 被推到前面等人评判的那个说法
words.core_image: 黑板上写下一句话，下面开始逐条验证它成不成立
examples: The proposition is easy to disprove.
He turned down the business proposition.
semantic_expansions: 命题（逻辑）：被推到前面等人验证的那句话
提议/主张：被推到前面等人接受的那个说法。同一个'推到前面待议'，一个求真一个求同意

words.root_logic: spec（看）→ species（一眼看去的样貌、种类）+ -al（…的）→ 属于某个单独种类的 → 特别的
words.recall_hint: spec（看）→ species（一眼看去的样貌、种类）+ -al → 单独属于某一类的，不与别的混同
words.origin: 拉丁语 specialis：species（种类、样貌）← specere（看）
words.native_definition: different from what is usual, or for a particular purpose
words.core_concept: belonging to a kind of its own – 自成一类，不与一般的混同
words.core_image: 货架上单独隔出一格，标签跟旁边整排都不一样
examples: Today's special is grilled fish.
She needs special equipment for the job.
semantic_expansions: 特别的：自成一类，与一般不同
专门的：为某一类单独准备的
特价品（名词）：单独列出的那一项。三义共享'自成一类、单独列出'

words.root_logic: special（自成一类的）+ -ist（人）→ 专攻某一类的人 → 专家
words.origin: 拉丁语 specialis（特定的）+ -ist（从事者）
words.native_definition: a person who is highly trained in one particular field
words.core_concept: one who works within a single kind – 只在某一类里深耕的人
words.core_image: 转诊单上写着要找只看这一种病的那位医生
examples: She was referred to a heart specialist.
We hired a specialist in tax law.
semantic_expansions: 专家与专科医生：都是'只在某一类里深耕的人'，一个泛指一个专指医生

words.root_logic: special（自成一类的）+ -ize（使成为）→ 把自己收进某一类专做 → 专攻
words.origin: 拉丁语 specialis（特定的）+ -ize
words.native_definition: to concentrate on one particular area of work or study
words.core_concept: narrowing oneself into one kind – 把自己收窄到某一类里去做
words.core_image: 原本什么都做的铺子改成只卖一种东西，招牌也换了
examples: He specializes in medieval history.
The firm specializes in shipping law.
semantic_expansions: 专攻与专门研究：都是'把自己收窄到某一类里'，中文按领域分了两个词

words.root_logic: special（自成一类的）+ -ity（名词）→ 自己那一类最拿手的东西 → 专长、特色菜
words.recall_hint: special（自成一类的）+ -ity → 自己那一类里最拿手的：可以是专长，也可以是店里的招牌菜
words.origin: 拉丁语 specialitas：specialis（特定的）
words.native_definition: an area in which someone is expert, or a product a place is known for
words.core_concept: the one kind one is known for – 自己那一类里最见长的
words.core_image: 小店门口写着本店只此一样做得最好
examples: Contract law is her speciality.
The speciality here is roast duck.
semantic_expansions: 专长：自己那一类里最见长的本事
特色菜/特产：某地那一类里最拿手的东西。同一个'最见长的那一类'，一个说人一个说物

words.root_logic: spec（看、种类）+ -ify（使成为）→ 把要哪一类说得看得见 → 明确指定
words.origin: 拉丁语 specificare：species（种类）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: to state something clearly and exactly
words.core_concept: naming exactly which one – 把究竟是哪一个说得清清楚楚
words.core_image: 订单上不写'螺丝'，而写明规格、长度、数量
examples: Please specify the size you need.
The contract specifies a two-week notice.
semantic_expansions: 明确指定与具体说明：都是'把究竟是哪一个说清楚'，一个偏选定一个偏描述

words.root_logic: specify（明确指定）+ -ation（名词）→ 被逐项写明的那份要求 → 规格说明
words.origin: 拉丁语 specificare：species（种类）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: a detailed description of how something must be made or done
words.core_concept: the written statement of exactly what is required – 把要求逐项写明的那份东西
words.core_image: 图纸旁边一张表，尺寸公差材料逐行列清
examples: The parts were built to specification.
Read the specification before bidding.
semantic_expansions: 规格说明/技术要求/明细：都是'把要求逐项写明的那份东西'，中文按行业分了三个词

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ spic（spec 的变体，看）+ -uous → 完全看得见的 → 显眼的
words.origin: 拉丁语 conspicuus：com-（完全）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: easy to notice because of being different or striking
words.core_concept: fully in view, impossible to miss – 完全在视野里，想不看见都难
words.core_image: 一片黑西装里那件红外套，一进门就先看见它
examples: He felt conspicuous in his bright jacket.
She showed conspicuous courage.
semantic_expansions: 显眼的与引人注目的：都是'完全在视野里、想不看见都难'，中文两种说法同一个内核

words.root_logic: retro-（向后）+ spect（看）→ 回头往后看 → 回顾
words.origin: 拉丁语 retrospicere：retro-（向后）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: a look back at past events
words.core_concept: looking back at what has passed – 回头看已经过去的那一段
words.core_image: 站在山顶回头，才看清上山那条路是怎么绕的
examples: In retrospect, the decision was wrong.
The exhibition is a retrospect of her career.
semantic_expansions: 回顾与回想：都是'回头看已过去的那一段'——与 prospect（向前看）正好构成一对

words.root_logic: prospect（向前看）+ -ive（…的）→ 属于往前看到的那一段的 → 未来的、潜在的
words.origin: 拉丁语 prospicere：pro-（向前）+ specere（看）
words.native_definition: likely to happen or to become something in the future
words.core_concept: belonging to what lies ahead in view – 属于往前望能看到的那一段
words.core_image: 看房的人还没签约，但已经在量窗帘尺寸
examples: Prospective buyers toured the flat.
She met her prospective employer.
semantic_expansions: 未来的/潜在的/预期的：都是'属于往前望能看到的那一段'，中文按侧重分了三个词

words.root_logic: aequ（平、相等）+ -al（…的）→ 两边一样多、一样高的 → 相等的
words.origin: 拉丁语 aequalis：aequus（平的、相等的）
words.native_definition: the same in amount, size, or value
words.core_concept: the same on both sides – 两边一样，不偏不多
words.core_image: 天平两盘停在同一高度，谁也不往下沉
examples: Cut the cake into equal pieces.
All citizens are equal before the law.
No one can equal her record.
semantic_expansions: 相等的：数量上两边一样
平等的：地位上两边一样
比得上（动词）：达到与对方相同的高度。三义共享'两边一样平'

words.root_logic: equal（相等的）+ -ity（名词）→ 两边一样的那个状态 → 平等
words.origin: 拉丁语 aequalitas：aequus（相等的）
words.native_definition: the state of being the same in rights, status, or amount
words.core_concept: the state of both sides being the same – 两边处在同一水平的那个状态
words.core_image: 两条起跑线画在同一位置，没人靠前半步
examples: The movement fought for racial equality.
Equality of opportunity matters most.
semantic_expansions: 平等与相等：都是'两边处在同一水平'，一个说地位一个说数量

words.root_logic: equate（使相等）+ -ion（名词）→ 声明两边相等的那个式子 → 方程
words.origin: 拉丁语 aequatio：aequare（使相等）← aequus（相等的）
words.native_definition: a mathematical statement that two amounts are equal, or a situation with several factors
words.core_concept: a statement that two sides are the same – 声明两边相等的那个式子
words.core_image: 等号两边各一串符号，谁改动一边另一边就得跟着改
examples: Solve the equation for x.
Cost is only one part of the equation.
semantic_expansions: 方程/等式：声明两边相等的式子
综合情况（part of the equation）：要一起考虑、彼此制约的那一组因素。同一个'两边须相称'，一个在数学一个在事理

words.root_logic: ad-（朝向）+ equ（相等）+ -ate → 与所需相当的 → 足够的
words.origin: 拉丁语 adaequatus：ad-（朝向）+ aequus（相等的）——'与之相当'
words.native_definition: enough for what is needed, though not more
words.core_concept: matching what is required, no more – 与所需相当，刚够而不多
words.core_image: 秤上的分量正好压到刻度线，不多一克
examples: The lighting is adequate for reading.
Her explanation was adequate but dull.
semantic_expansions: 足够的/适当的：与所需相当
勉强够的：刚好相当、不再有余。同一个'与所需持平'，语气上从中性到略带保留

words.root_logic: claimare（喊出）本身即词根，无前缀 → 喊出来说某物归自己、或某事为真
words.recall_hint: claimare（喊出）本身即词根 → 喊出来说某物归自己或某事为真；名词则是喊出来的那份主张
words.origin: 拉丁语 clamare（喊、宣告）经古法语 clamer 进入英语
