words.native_definition: to say something is true without proof, or to demand what is yours
words.core_concept: calling out that something is yours or true – 喊出来说这归我、或这是真的
words.core_image: 在认领处举手说那只箱子是自己的
examples: He claims to have finished it alone.
You can claim a refund within a month.
semantic_expansions: 声称/主张：喊出来说某事为真
索取（退款）：喊出来说这份归我。同一个'喊出来宣告'，宣告的是事实还是所有权

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ claim（喊）→ 一下子喊出来 → 惊叫
words.origin: 拉丁语 exclamare：ex-（向外）+ clamare（喊）
words.native_definition: to cry out suddenly, especially from surprise or strong feeling
words.core_concept: letting a cry burst outward – 情绪把喊声一下推到外面
words.core_image: 看到账单的瞬间，声音先冲出了嘴
examples: "That is impossible!" she exclaimed.
He exclaimed in delight at the news.
semantic_expansions: 惊叫与呼喊：都是'喊声一下推到外面'，一个偏意外一个偏音量

words.root_logic: pro-（向前、公开）+ claim（喊）→ 当众喊出来 → 宣布
words.origin: 拉丁语 proclamare：pro-（向前）+ clamare（喊）
words.native_definition: to announce something publicly and officially
words.core_concept: calling it out before everyone – 当着众人把它喊出来
words.core_image: 使者站在台阶上展开卷轴念出诏令
examples: Independence was proclaimed that morning.
The banner proclaimed their victory.
semantic_expansions: 宣布/宣告：当众正式喊出来
公然表明：不加掩饰地喊出来。同一个'当众喊出'，一个偏程序一个偏姿态

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ claim（喊出主张）→ 喊着把原属自己的要回来 → 收回
words.origin: 拉丁语 reclamare：re-（往回）+ clamare（喊）
words.native_definition: to get something back, or to make land usable again
words.core_concept: calling back what was yours – 喊着把原本属于自己的要回来
words.core_image: 行李转盘边出示存根，把箱子领回手里
examples: She reclaimed her luggage at the desk.
The land was reclaimed from the sea.
semantic_expansions: 收回/取回：把原属自己的要回来
开垦（滩地）：把土地从荒废或海水那里要回来。同一个'要回原本该属于的'，对象是物还是地

words.root_logic: liber（不受束缚的）+ -ty（名词）→ 身上没有绑着东西的那个状态 → 自由
words.origin: 拉丁语 libertas：liber（自由的）
words.native_definition: the state of being free from control or restriction
words.core_concept: the state of being unbound – 身上没有束缚的那个状态
words.core_image: 牢门推开，人走出来时手上什么都没锁着
examples: They fought for liberty.
Civil liberties are protected by law.
semantic_expansions: 自由与自由权：都是'身上没有束缚的状态'，一个说状态一个说受保障的权利

words.root_logic: liber（自由的）+ -al（…的）→ 给人留余地的、不设死框的 → 开明的；引申为给得宽 → 大量的
words.recall_hint: liber（不受束缚）+ -al → 不给人设死框、留余地的；引申为给东西也给得宽
words.origin: 拉丁语 liberalis：liber（自由的）——原指'适合自由人的'
words.native_definition: open to new ideas and to others' freedom; also generous in amount
words.core_concept: leaving room rather than binding – 不勒紧，给人和量都留余地
words.core_image: 规矩写得宽，很多做法都容得下
examples: She holds liberal views on education.
Add a liberal amount of butter.
semantic_expansions: 开明的/自由主义的：不给人设死框
大量的：给的量也不勒紧。同一个'留余地'，一个对人一个对量

words.root_logic: liber（自由的）+ -ate（使成为）→ 使之不再受束缚 → 解放
words.origin: 拉丁语 liberare：liber（自由的）
words.native_definition: to set someone free from confinement or oppression
words.core_concept: making someone unbound – 把束缚从人身上去掉
words.core_image: 锁链解开落地，人第一次能直起身走路
examples: The city was liberated in 1944.
Technology liberated her from routine tasks.
semantic_expansions: 解放与释放：都是'把束缚从人身上去掉'，一个偏群体一个偏个体

words.root_logic: de-（彻底）+ liber（此处取 libra 天平义，称量）+ -ate → 彻底称量过才做的 → 深思熟虑的、故意的
words.recall_hint: de-（彻底）+ libra（天平、称量）+ -ate → 在心里彻底称量过之后才做的；所以既指从容不迫，也指并非无心
words.origin: 拉丁语 deliberare：de-（彻底）+ librare（称量）← libra（天平）
words.native_definition: done on purpose after thinking, or slow and careful
words.core_concept: done after weighing it out fully – 在心里称量过之后才做
words.core_image: 下棋的人手停在棋子上方很久才落下
examples: It was a deliberate insult.
She spoke in a slow, deliberate voice.
semantic_expansions: 故意的：称量过才做，不是无心
深思熟虑的/从容的：因为在称量，所以不急。同一个'心里过了秤'，一个说动机一个说节奏

words.root_logic: clud（关闭）经古法语 clos 进入英语，无前缀 → 把开口合上；引申为距离上没有缝隙 → 近的
words.recall_hint: clud（关闭）的法语形，无前缀 → 把开口合上；两样东西之间没有缝隙时也用它
words.origin: 拉丁语 claudere（关闭）经古法语 clos 进入英语
words.native_definition: to shut something, or to be at a short distance
words.core_concept: bringing the gap to nothing – 把中间那道缝合到没有
words.core_image: 抽屉推到底，缝隙一点点消失直到看不见
examples: Please close the window.
The station is close to my flat.
They remain close friends.
semantic_expansions: 关闭：把开口合到没有
接近的/亲密的：两者之间的距离合到几乎没有。同一个'缝隙归零'，一个是物理开口一个是间距

words.root_logic: dis-（去除）+ close（关闭）→ 把合上的打开 → 透露
words.origin: 拉丁语 dis-（去除）+ claudere（关闭）经古法语 desclore
words.native_definition: to make known something that was kept secret
words.core_concept: opening what was kept shut – 把一直合着的打开
words.core_image: 抽屉拉开，里面的文件第一次被别人看到
examples: He refused to disclose his sources.
The scan disclosed a small fracture.
semantic_expansions: 透露/披露：把合着的信息打开
使显露（检查结果）：让原本看不见的露出来。同一个'开合上的东西'，一个是主动说一个是被查出

words.root_logic: en-（使…进入）+ close（关闭）→ 把某物关进里面 → 围住、附上
words.origin: 拉丁语 in-（进入）+ claudere（关闭）经古法语 enclore
words.native_definition: to surround something, or to put something inside an envelope
words.core_concept: shutting something inside a boundary – 把某物关在一圈界线之内
words.core_image: 篱笆围了一圈，羊在里面出不去
examples: A high wall encloses the garden.
I enclose a copy of the receipt.
semantic_expansions: 围住：用界线把某物关在里面
附上/封入（信件）：把纸片关进信封里。同一个'关进界线之内'，界线是篱笆还是信封

words.root_logic: enclose（围住）+ -ure（名词）→ 被围起来的那块地方，或随信封入之物 → 围场、附件
words.recall_hint: enclose（关进界线之内）+ -ure → 被围起来的那块地方；也指随信一起封进去的那份东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 in-（进入）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: an area surrounded by a barrier, or something included with a letter
words.core_concept: the space shut in, or what is shut in – 被围住的那块地方，或被封进的那份东西
words.core_image: 动物园里一圈栏杆围出的场地，动物在里面走动
examples: The birds were kept in a large enclosure.
Please see the enclosure for details.
semantic_expansions: 围场/圈地：被围起来的那块地方
附件：随信被封进去的那份东西。同一个'被关在里面的'，一个是空间一个是物

words.root_logic: as-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ sume（取用）→ 把某个前提取来当真的用 → 假定；把职位取到自己身上 → 就任
words.recall_hint: as-（朝向）+ sume（取用）→ 未经证实就把某个说法取来当真的用；也指把职位或责任取到自己身上
words.origin: 拉丁语 assumere：ad-（朝向）+ sumere（取用）
words.native_definition: to accept something as true without proof, or to take on a role
words.core_concept: taking something up as given – 未经验证就把它取来当作已定
words.core_image: 顺手从架上取过一件工具就用，没检查它对不对
examples: I assumed you had already left.
She assumed control of the department.
semantic_expansions: 假定：把未经验证的说法取来当真用
承担/就任：把职位或责任取到自己身上。同一个'取来就用'，取的是前提还是职务

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ sume（取用）→ 全部取用掉、一点不剩 → 消耗
words.origin: 拉丁语 consumere：com-（完全）+ sumere（取用）
words.native_definition: to use up, eat, or drink something completely
words.core_concept: taking it up until none is left – 取用到一点不剩
words.core_image: 油表指针一路走到底，箱里空了
examples: The city consumes vast amounts of water.
He consumed the whole loaf.
semantic_expansions: 消耗/消费：取用到不剩
吃光：把食物取用到不剩。同一个'完全取用'，对象是资源还是食物

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ sume（取用）→ 事先就把它取来当真的 → 推定
words.origin: 拉丁语 praesumere：prae-（在前）+ sumere（取用）
words.native_definition: to suppose something is true before knowing, or to act without permission
words.core_concept: taking it as true ahead of proof – 在证据之前就先取它为真
words.core_image: 还没验完，先按'他没做过'来办
examples: The accused is presumed innocent.
I would not presume to correct her.
semantic_expansions: 推定/假设：在证据之前先取它为真
擅自：未经许可就把资格取来用。同一个'事先取用'，取的是判断还是资格

words.root_logic: re-（重新）+ sume（取用）→ 把放下的重新拿起来 → 继续
words.origin: 拉丁语 resumere：re-（重新）+ sumere（取用）
words.native_definition: to begin again after stopping
words.core_concept: taking up again what was set down – 把放下的那件事重新拿起来
words.core_image: 书签取出来，从上次停下的那页往下读
examples: Talks will resume on Monday.
She resumed her seat quietly.
semantic_expansions: 继续/重新开始：把放下的重新拿起
恢复（原位）：回到原来那个位置。同一个'重新取用'，取的是进程还是位置

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ spire（呼气）→ 把一口气吹进对方心里 → 激励
words.origin: 拉丁语 inspirare：in-（进入）+ spirare（呼吸）——原指神把气吹入人体
words.native_definition: to fill someone with the urge to do or feel something
words.core_concept: breathing something into another – 把一口气吹进对方心里
words.core_image: 一句话吹进人心里，原本瘪着的劲头鼓了起来
examples: Her courage inspired the whole team.
The landscape inspired his best work.
semantic_expansions: 激励：把劲头吹进人心里
启发/赋予灵感：把念头吹进人脑中。同一个'吹气入内'，吹进的是劲头还是想法

words.root_logic: inspire（吹气入内）+ -ation（名词）→ 被吹进来的那口气 → 灵感
words.origin: 拉丁语 inspiratio：in-（进入）+ spirare（呼吸）
words.native_definition: a sudden good idea, or the person or thing that gives it
words.core_concept: what has been breathed in – 被吹进来的那口气
words.core_image: 半夜忽然想通一件事，像有谁往脑子里吹了一口气
examples: The idea came to her in a flash of inspiration.
His mother was his greatest inspiration.
semantic_expansions: 灵感：被吹进脑中的那个念头
鼓舞/启发：被吹进心里的那股劲。同一个'吹进来的气'，落在想法还是心气

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ spir（呼吸）+ -acy → 几个人凑在一起同呼吸密谈 → 阴谋
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ spir（呼吸）+ -acy → 几个人头凑在一起、气都吹到彼此脸上地密商
words.origin: 拉丁语 conspiratio：com-（一起）+ spirare（呼吸）——'同呼吸、串通'
words.native_definition: a secret plan by several people to do something harmful or illegal
words.core_concept: several breathing together in secret – 几个人凑在一起低声共谋
words.core_image: 几个人围成一圈低头说话，声音低到只有圈内听得见
examples: They were charged with conspiracy to defraud.
The film is about a political conspiracy.
semantic_expansions: 阴谋/共谋/同谋：都是'几人凑在一起低声共商'，中文按角度分了三个词

words.root_logic: spir（此处取 spira'盘绕'义）+ -al（…的）→ 一圈圈盘绕上升或下降的 → 螺旋
words.recall_hint: spira（盘绕）+ -al → 一圈圈绕着上或下的形状；用在局势上则指越绕越糟
words.origin: 拉丁语 spiralis ← spira（盘绕、卷曲），与 spirare（呼吸）同族但取'盘绕'义
words.native_definition: a curve that winds around a centre, or a continuous worsening
words.core_concept: winding round and round while moving – 绕着中心一圈圈地往上或往下
words.core_image: 楼梯绕着中柱一圈圈向上，每转一圈高一层
examples: A spiral staircase led to the tower.
Prices entered an upward spiral.
semantic_expansions: 螺旋/螺旋形的：绕着中心一圈圈地走
恶性循环：局势一圈圈绕着往下。同一个'盘绕着推进'，一个是形状一个是趋势

words.root_logic: soci（同伴）+ -ety（名词）→ 结伴生活的那一整群人 → 社会
words.origin: 拉丁语 societas：socius（同伴）
words.native_definition: people living together in a community, or an organized group with a shared interest
words.core_concept: people bound together as companions – 以同伴关系联结在一起的那群人
words.core_image: 街上的人彼此不认识，却守着同一套规矩过日子
examples: Modern society depends on trust.
She joined the historical society.
semantic_expansions: 社会：以同伴关系联结的一整群人
社团：因共同兴趣结伴的一小群人。同一个'结伴而成的群'，规模不同

words.root_logic: soci（结伴）+ -able（能…的）→ 乐于与人结伴的 → 好交际的
words.origin: 拉丁语 sociabilis：socius（同伴）
words.native_definition: enjoying the company of other people
words.core_concept: ready to be in others' company – 乐意与人待在一处
words.core_image: 一进屋就坐到人多的那一桌
examples: He is sociable and easy to talk to.
It was a sociable evening.
semantic_expansions: 好交际的与友善的：都是'乐意与人待在一处'，一个偏主动一个偏态度

words.root_logic: as-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ soci（结伴）+ -ate → 把两者结成同伴 → 联想、结交
words.recall_hint: as-（朝向）+ soci（结伴）+ -ate → 把两样东西结成一对同伴：可以是两个念头，也可以是两个人
words.origin: 拉丁语 associare：ad-（朝向）+ socius（同伴）
words.native_definition: to connect one thing with another in the mind, or to spend time with someone
words.core_concept: pairing two things as companions – 把两者配成同伴
words.core_image: 提到海就想到咸味，两者在脑中拴在一起
examples: Most people associate red with danger.
He associates mainly with musicians.
semantic_expansions: 联想/联系：把两个念头配成一对
结交/同事：把两个人配成同伴。同一个'结成同伴'，配的是概念还是人

words.root_logic: associate（结成同伴）+ -ion（名词）→ 结伴而成的组织，或脑中结起的那层联系 → 协会、联想
words.recall_hint: associate（结成同伴）+ -ion → 结伴而成的那个组织；也指脑中两样东西之间结起的那层联系
words.origin: 拉丁语 associatio：ad-（朝向）+ socius（同伴）
words.native_definition: an organized group, or a mental connection between things
words.core_concept: what is formed by pairing – 结成同伴所形成的东西
words.core_image: 会员名册第一页写着成立日期和宗旨
examples: She chairs the tenants' association.
The word has negative associations.
semantic_expansions: 协会：人结伴而成的组织
联想/关联：念头之间结起的那层联系。同一个'结成的关系'，结的是人还是概念

words.root_logic: soci（同伴、结伴）+ -al（…的）→ 与人结伴相关的 → 社会的、社交的
words.origin: 拉丁语 socialis：socius（同伴）
words.native_definition: relating to society, or to activities where people meet each other
words.core_concept: having to do with people joined together – 与人结伴这件事相关
words.core_image: 同一栋楼里的人共用楼梯、垃圾房和一套规矩
examples: Social problems cannot be solved overnight.
She has a busy social life.
Bees are social insects.
semantic_expansions: 社会的：与整群人相关
社交的：与人往来相关
群居的（生物）：结伴生活的。三义共享'与结伴相关'

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ cept（capere 的变体，抓取）→ 把许多个例的共性一把抓起来 → 概念
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ cept（抓取）→ 把许多个例的共同点一把抓住，剩下的那个东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 conceptus：com-（一起）+ capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: a general idea formed from particular cases
words.core_concept: what is grasped as common to many cases – 从许多个例里一把抓出来的那个共性
words.core_image: 从一堆苹果橘子里抓出'水果'这个东西，手里却什么都没有
examples: The concept is simple but powerful.
He struggled with the concept of infinity.
semantic_expansions: 概念与观念：都是'从许多个例里抓出的共性'，一个偏客观一个偏个人持有

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ cept（抓取）→ 把这一项从整体里抓出去 → 除…之外
words.origin: 拉丁语 exceptus：ex-（向外）+ capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: not including; other than
words.core_concept: taken out of the group – 被从整体里抓出去的那一项
words.core_image: 名单上一个名字被圈出来挪到旁边，其余照旧
examples: The shop opens daily except Sunday.
Everyone agreed except me.
semantic_expansions: 除…之外与除外：都是'被从整体里抓出去的那一项'，中文一个作介词一个作动词

words.root_logic: re-（回、往回）+ ceipt（cept 的变体，抓取）→ 证明已把东西接过来的那张纸 → 收据
words.origin: 拉丁语 receptus：re-（往回）+ capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: a written statement that money or goods have been received
words.core_concept: proof that something was taken in – 证明已经接到手的那份凭据
words.core_image: 付完钱递过来一张小纸条，上面写着收了多少
examples: Keep the receipt in case of return.
Please confirm receipt of this email.
semantic_expansions: 收据：证明已接到手的那张凭据
收到/接收（行为）：把东西接过来这件事。同一个'接到手'，一个是凭据一个是动作

words.root_logic: sus-（sub- 的变体，从下）+ cept（抓取）+ -ible（易…的）→ 底下容易被抓住的 → 易受影响的
words.recall_hint: sus-（从下）+ cept（抓取）+ -ible → 底子上容易被抓住、挡不住的
words.origin: 拉丁语 susceptibilis：sub-（从下）+ capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: easily affected or harmed by something
words.core_concept: easily taken hold of from below – 底子上容易被抓住、挡不住
words.core_image: 刚淋过雨的人在风口站着，病一来就抓住了他
examples: Young trees are susceptible to frost.
He is susceptible to flattery.
semantic_expansions: 易感染的（疾病）：身体底子容易被病抓住
易受影响的/敏感的：心思容易被外力抓住。同一个'底下容易被抓牢'，抓的是病还是话

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ cept（抓取）→ 朝自己这边接过来 → 接受
words.origin: 拉丁语 accipere：ad-（朝向）+ capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: to agree to take or receive something offered
words.core_concept: taking toward oneself what is offered – 把递来的东西朝自己这边接过来
words.core_image: 对方伸手递过来，你把它接到自己手里
examples: She accepted the offer at once.
He refuses to accept defeat.
semantic_expansions: 接受（东西）：把递来的接到手里
承认/认可（事实）：把说法接进心里。同一个'朝自己接过来'，接的是物还是判断

words.root_logic: certus（已定的）本身即词根，无前缀 → 已经定下不再摇摆的；也用于指明是那一个而不泛指
words.recall_hint: certus（已定的）本身即词根 → 已经定下、不再摇摆；也用来指明是那一个而不是随便哪个
words.origin: 拉丁语 certus（已定的）← cernere（分辨）
words.native_definition: having no doubt, or referring to a particular one
words.core_concept: settled so that it no longer wavers – 已经定住，不再摇摆
words.core_image: 钉子钉到底，手推它也不动
examples: I am certain he locked the door.
Certain species cannot survive here.
semantic_expansions: 确定的/肯定的：心里已经定住不摇摆
某个：已经定下是哪一个，只是不说出来。同一个'已定'，一个说信念一个说所指

words.root_logic: certain（已定的）+ -ly（副词）→ 以不容摇摆的方式 → 当然
words.origin: 拉丁语 certus（已定的）
words.native_definition: without doubt; also used to agree readily
words.core_concept: in a way that admits no doubt – 以不留疑问的方式
words.core_image: 对方话没说完就已经点头了
examples: It is certainly worth trying.
"May I sit here?" "Certainly."
semantic_expansions: 确实/无疑：以不留疑问的方式陈述
当然（应答）：不必犹豫就答应。同一个'不容摇摆'，一个用于陈述一个用于应答

words.root_logic: certain（已定的）+ -ty（名词）→ 已经定住的那个状态，或必定发生的那件事 → 确定性
words.recall_hint: certain（已定的）+ -ty → 心里定住不摇摆的那个状态；也指那件必定会发生的事
words.origin: 拉丁语 certitudo：certus（已定的）
words.native_definition: the state of being sure, or something that is bound to happen
words.core_concept: the state of being settled – 已经定住、不再摇摆的那个状态
words.core_image: 结论下面画了双横线，再没有讨论的余地
examples: We cannot predict the outcome with certainty.
Death is the one certainty.
semantic_expansions: 确定性：心里定住的那个状态
必然的事：注定要发生、无从改变的那件。同一个'已定'，一个在心里一个在事上

words.root_logic: as-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ certain（已定）→ 弄到确定为止 → 查明
words.origin: 拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ certus（已定的）经古法语 acertener
words.native_definition: to find out something for sure
words.core_concept: working at it until it is settled – 一直弄到它定下来为止
words.core_image: 核对了三份记录，直到能确认那个日期
examples: Police are trying to ascertain the cause.
We must ascertain whether he agrees.
semantic_expansions: 查明/弄清：一直查到它定下来
确定（动词）：使之不再摇摆。同一个'弄到已定'，一个偏过程一个偏结果

words.root_logic: norma（角尺）+ -al（…的）→ 合乎那把尺的 → 正常的
words.origin: 拉丁语 normalis：norma（木匠的角尺）
words.native_definition: usual, typical, or as expected
words.core_concept: matching the measuring square – 拿尺一比正好合上
words.core_image: 角尺靠上去，木料四角都是直的
examples: Her temperature is back to normal.
It is normal to feel nervous.
semantic_expansions: 正常的/通常的：拿尺一比合得上
标准的：就是那把尺本身所定的。同一个'合乎尺度'，一个说符合一个说尺度

words.root_logic: ab-（离开）+ norm（角尺）+ -al → 偏离那把尺的 → 异常的
words.origin: 拉丁语 abnormis：ab-（离开）+ norma（角尺）
words.native_definition: different from what is usual, often in a worrying way
words.core_concept: departing from the measuring square – 拿尺一比对不上
words.core_image: 角尺靠上去，木料有一角明显歪出缝
examples: The scan showed abnormal cells.
Such heat is abnormal for April.
semantic_expansions: 异常的与不正常的：都是'拿尺一比对不上'，中文两种说法同一个内核

words.root_logic: norma（角尺）本身即词根，无词缀 → 用来比对的那把尺，即通行的标准
words.origin: 拉丁语 norma（木匠的角尺）
words.native_definition: the usual or expected standard of behaviour
words.core_concept: the square everything is measured against – 大家拿来比对的那把尺
words.core_image: 工地上人人手边都有同一把角尺，谁做的都要靠它比一比
examples: Working late became the norm there.
Social norms vary between cultures.
semantic_expansions: 规范/准则：大家拿来比对的那把尺
常态：合乎那把尺的通常状况。同一个'比对之尺'，一个是尺一个是尺下的常况

words.root_logic: normal（合乎尺的）+ -ization（使成为…的过程）→ 使之回到尺内的过程 → 正常化
words.origin: 拉丁语 normalis（合乎角尺的）+ -ization
words.native_definition: the process of making something normal or standard again
words.core_concept: bringing something back within the square – 把偏出去的弄回尺内
words.core_image: 歪掉的门框被撬正，角尺靠上去又合得上了
examples: The normalization of relations took years.
Data normalization improves comparison.
semantic_expansions: 正常化：把偏出去的弄回尺内
标准化：使各处都照同一把尺。同一个'回到尺内'，一个说恢复一个说统一

words.root_logic: testis（见证、检验）本身即词根，无词缀 → 让事物自己作证，看它到底如何
words.recall_hint: testis（见证、检验）本身即词根 → 摆出条件让事物自己作证，看它究竟如何
words.origin: 拉丁语 testum（陶钵，古时用于试炼金属）← testis（见证）
words.native_definition: a procedure to find out how good, true, or able something is
words.core_concept: putting something in a position to show what it is – 摆出条件让它自己显出真相
words.core_image: 把金属放进钵里烧，是真是假自己显出来
examples: The blood test came back clear.
She failed her driving test.
semantic_expansions: 测试/检验：摆出条件让事物自己显出真相
考试：让人自己显出会不会。同一个'让它自证'，对象是物还是人

words.root_logic: testi（见证人）+ -fy（使成为）→ 站出来充当见证 → 作证
words.origin: 拉丁语 testificari：testis（见证人）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: to give evidence in court, or to serve as proof of something
words.core_concept: standing forth as a witness – 站出来充当见证
words.core_image: 证人席上举手，说出自己亲眼看见的
examples: She refused to testify against him.
The scars testify to years of work.
semantic_expansions: 作证（法庭）：人站出来充当见证
证明/表明（物）：某物本身充当了见证。同一个'充当见证'，见证者是人还是物

words.root_logic: con-（一起、相对）+ test（作证）→ 双方各自举证相争 → 竞赛；作动词是提出异议 → 争辩
words.recall_hint: con-（相对）+ test（作证）→ 双方各自举证相争；名词是那场较量，动词是提出异议
words.origin: 拉丁语 contestari：com-（一起）+ testari（作证）——原指'传唤双方作证以起诉'
words.native_definition: a competition, or to argue that something is wrong
words.core_concept: two sides each bringing witness against the other – 双方各自举证相争
words.core_image: 两边各摆出自己的证据，让人评谁站得住
examples: She won the singing contest.
He contested the result in court.
semantic_expansions: 竞赛/争夺：双方各出所长相争
争辩（动词）：举出反证提出异议。同一个'相对举证'，一个在赛场一个在辩场

words.root_logic: pro-（当众、向前）+ test（作证）→ 当众声明自己不同意 → 抗议
words.origin: 拉丁语 protestari：pro-（向前）+ testari（作证）
words.native_definition: to express strong disagreement, especially publicly
words.core_concept: declaring one's objection before all – 当众把不同意声明出来
words.core_image: 举着牌子站在门口，让所有路过的人都看见那句话
examples: Thousands protested against the new law.
He protested that he had not been told.
semantic_expansions: 抗议/反对：当众声明不同意
申辩：当众声明事实并非如此。同一个'当众作证'，一个反对处置一个陈述实情

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ mun（共有、职责）+ -icate → 使某物成为双方共有的 → 沟通
words.origin: 拉丁语 communicare：communis（共有的）← com-（一起）+ munus（职责、赠予）
words.native_definition: to share information so that it is understood
words.core_concept: making something held in common – 使某样东西变成双方共有
words.core_image: 同一份消息在两人脑中都有了，内容一致
examples: Good managers communicate clearly.
The disease is communicated by touch.
semantic_expansions: 沟通/传达：使信息成为双方共有
传染：使病成为双方共有。同一个'化为共有'，共有的是消息还是病

words.root_logic: communicate（化为共有）+ -ion（名词）→ 使之共有这件事，或所传之物 → 交流
words.origin: 拉丁语 communicatio：communis（共有的）
words.native_definition: the exchange of information, or a message sent
words.core_concept: the making of something common between people – 使信息成为共有这件事
words.core_image: 两条线路接通，一头说话另一头同时听见
examples: Communication between departments broke down.
We received your communication yesterday.
semantic_expansions: 交流/通信：使信息成为共有这件事
信件（正式）：所传的那份东西。同一个'化为共有'，一个是过程一个是所传之物

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ mun（共有）+ -ity（名词）→ 有共同之物的那群人 → 社区
words.origin: 拉丁语 communitas：communis（共有的）
words.native_definition: a group of people living in one place or sharing something in common
words.core_concept: people holding something in common – 共有某样东西的那群人
words.core_image: 同一片街区的人共用一口井、一条路
examples: The community raised funds for the school.
She belongs to the research community.
semantic_expansions: 社区：共用同一片地方的人
群体/共同体：共有某样东西的人。同一个'有共同之物'，共有的是地方还是志趣

words.root_logic: commun（共有的）+ -ism（主张）→ 主张财产共有的那套学说 → 共产主义
words.origin: 拉丁语 communis（共有的）+ -ism
words.native_definition: a political system in which property is owned collectively
words.core_concept: the doctrine that things be held in common – 主张财物共有的那套学说
words.core_image: 田地不写谁的名字，收成按人分
examples: The book traces the rise of communism.
He studied the economics of communism.

words.root_logic: gradus（一步、一级）本身即词根，无词缀 → 阶梯上的某一级，即所处的那一档
words.recall_hint: gradus（一步、一级）本身即词根 → 阶梯上的某一级，即所处的那一档：分数、年级、坡度都是
words.origin: 拉丁语 gradus（一步、等级）
words.native_definition: a level of quality or rank, a school year, or a slope
words.core_concept: one step on a scale – 阶梯上的某一级
words.core_image: 台阶从下往上编号，站在第几级一目了然
examples: She got the highest grade in the class.
He teaches fourth grade.
The road has a steep grade here.
semantic_expansions: 等级/分数：阶梯上的那一级
年级：学制阶梯上的那一级
坡度：路面每步抬升的那个量。四义共享'阶梯上的一级'

words.root_logic: grad（一步）+ -ual（…的）→ 一步一步来的 → 逐渐的
words.origin: 拉丁语 gradualis：gradus（一步）
words.native_definition: happening slowly over a period of time
words.core_concept: advancing one step at a time – 一步一步地推进，不跳跃
words.core_image: 水位每天涨一指，看一天看不出，看一月很明显
examples: There has been a gradual improvement.
The slope is long but gradual.
semantic_expansions: 逐渐的与渐进的：都是'一步一步来、不跳跃'，中文两种说法同一个节奏

words.root_logic: up-（向上）+ grade（一级）→ 往上抬一级 → 升级
words.origin: 英语 up + 拉丁语 gradus（等级）
words.native_definition: to raise something to a higher level or better standard
words.core_concept: moving something up a step – 把它往上抬一级
words.core_image: 机票从后排换到前舱，位置往上挪了一档
examples: We upgraded the software last night.
She was upgraded to business class.
semantic_expansions: 升级/提升：往上抬一级
升舱：座位往上挪一档。同一个'上抬一级'，抬的是版本还是位置

words.root_logic: ag-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ gress（grad 的变体，走）+ -ive → 朝人步步逼近的 → 好斗的
words.recall_hint: ag-（朝向）+ gress（走）+ -ive → 朝对方步步逼近的；用在做法上则是进逼式的、不留余地
words.origin: 拉丁语 aggressivus：ad-（朝向）+ gradi（走）——'走向、进逼'
words.native_definition: ready to attack or confront, or forceful in pursuing aims
words.core_concept: stepping toward another to press on them – 一步步朝对方逼过去
words.core_image: 对面的人每说一句就往前迈半步，人只能后退
examples: The dog became aggressive when cornered.
They took an aggressive approach to sales.
semantic_expansions: 好斗的/有攻击性的：朝人步步逼近
积极进取的（商业）：做法上步步进逼，不留余地。同一个'向前进逼'，褒贬随场合而变

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ fuse（倒）→ 几样东西倒在一起分不开 → 使混乱
words.origin: 拉丁语 confundere：com-（一起）+ fundere（倒出）
words.native_definition: to make someone unable to think clearly, or to mistake one thing for another
words.core_concept: pouring things together until they cannot be told apart – 倒在一起，分不出哪是哪
words.core_image: 两种颜料倒进同一个碗，搅完谁也捞不出来
examples: The signs only confused drivers.
People often confuse the two brothers.
semantic_expansions: 弄糊涂：把人脑中的东西搅在一起
混淆：把两样东西倒在一起分不清。同一个'倒在一起难分'，搅的是人还是事物

words.root_logic: dif-（dis- 的变体，四散）+ fuse（倒）→ 往四面倒开 → 扩散
words.origin: 拉丁语 diffundere：dis-（四散）+ fundere（倒出）
words.native_definition: to spread out over a wide area, or to make light softer
words.core_concept: pouring outward in all directions – 朝四面倒开、铺散
words.core_image: 一滴墨落进水里，颜色从中心朝各方向散开
examples: The scent diffused through the room.
A screen diffuses the lamplight.
semantic_expansions: 扩散/散播：朝四面倒开铺散
使柔和（光线）：把光散开不再集中。同一个'四散倒开'，散的是气味还是光

words.root_logic: fundere（倒出、熔化）本身即词根，无前缀 → 熔到一起成为一体；名词指熔断保护的那根丝
words.recall_hint: fundere（熔化、倒出）本身即词根 → 熔到一起成为一体；名词指电流过大时会先熔断的那根丝
words.origin: 拉丁语 fusus：fundere（倒出、熔化）
words.native_definition: to join into one by melting, or a safety device that melts to break a circuit
words.core_concept: melting two things into one – 熔到一起成为一体
words.core_image: 两段铁在炉火里烧红后压合，冷却后看不出接缝
examples: The two companies fused into one group.
The fuse blew during the storm.
semantic_expansions: 熔合/融合：熔到一起成为一体
保险丝：会先熔断的那根丝。同一个'熔'，一个是合一个是断

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ fuse（倒）→ 把递来的倒回去 → 拒绝
words.origin: 拉丁语 refundere：re-（往回）+ fundere（倒出）——'倒回去'
words.native_definition: to say no to something offered or requested
words.core_concept: pouring back what was offered – 把递过来的原样倒回去
words.core_image: 对方倒过来的茶被推回去，杯子原样送还
examples: She refused the offer without hesitating.
He refused to answer the question.
semantic_expansions: 拒绝与谢绝：都是'把递来的倒回去'，中文按客气程度分了两个词

words.root_logic: optare（选择）本身即词根，无词缀 → 在几个之中挑定自己要的那个
words.origin: 拉丁语 optare（选择、期望）
words.native_definition: to choose one thing rather than another
words.core_concept: settling on the one you want – 在几个之中挑定要的那个
words.core_image: 表格上三个方框，只在其中一个里打勾
examples: Most staff opted for the earlier shift.
She opted to study abroad.
semantic_expansions: 选择与抉择：都是'在几个之中挑定要的那个'，中文按分量轻重分了两个词

words.root_logic: opt（选择）+ -ion（名词）→ 可供挑选的那一项 → 选项
words.origin: 拉丁语 optio：optare（选择）
words.native_definition: one of the things that can be chosen, or the freedom to choose
words.core_concept: one of the things open to be chosen – 摆出来供人挑的那一项
words.core_image: 菜单上并排列着几行，每行都能点
examples: You have three options here.
Leaving early was not an option.
semantic_expansions: 选项：摆出来供挑的那一项
选择权：可以挑这件事本身。同一个'可挑之项'，一个指项一个指权

words.root_logic: option（选项）+ -al（…的）→ 属于可挑可不挑的 → 可选的
words.origin: 拉丁语 optio（选择）+ -al
words.native_definition: not required; left to one's choice
words.core_concept: left to the chooser, not imposed – 挑不挑由你，不强加
words.core_image: 报名表上那一栏标着可不填，空着也能提交
examples: The insurance is optional.
Attendance at the talk is optional.
semantic_expansions: 可选的与非必需的：都是'挑不挑由你、不强加'——与 compulsory（被推着非做不可）正好构成一对

words.root_logic: ad-（朝向）+ opt（选择）→ 挑中并把它拿到自己这边 → 采用；把孩子挑来归入自家 → 收养
words.recall_hint: ad-（朝向）+ opt（选择）→ 挑中并把它拿到自己这边：可以是一套做法，也可以是一个孩子
words.origin: 拉丁语 adoptare：ad-（朝向）+ optare（选择）
words.native_definition: to start using a method or attitude, or to take a child into one's family
words.core_concept: choosing something and taking it as one's own – 挑中它并把它变成自己的
words.core_image: 从几套方案里挑一套，然后照它办事
examples: The committee adopted the new rules.
They adopted a boy from overseas.
semantic_expansions: 采用/采取：挑中一套做法并照它办
收养：挑中一个孩子并归入自家。同一个'挑中并纳为己有'，纳的是做法还是人

words.root_logic: civis（市民）+ -il（…的）→ 与市民相关的 → 公民的；引申为像市民之间那样有礼 → 客气的
words.recall_hint: civis（市民）+ -il → 与市民身份相关的；引申为像市民相处那样守礼、不动武
words.origin: 拉丁语 civilis：civis（市民、公民）
words.native_definition: relating to citizens and their affairs, not military or religious; also polite
words.core_concept: belonging to citizens rather than to force – 属于市民之事，而非武力或神权
words.core_image: 法庭里两方各请律师陈述，没人动手
examples: Civil rights were extended that decade.
He gave a civil but cool reply.
semantic_expansions: 公民的/民事的：属于市民之事，与军事、宗教相对
客气的：像市民相处那样守礼。同一个'市民之道'，一个说范畴一个说举止

words.root_logic: civil（公民的）+ -ian（人）→ 身份是市民而非军人的那个人 → 平民
words.origin: 拉丁语 civilis（公民的）← civis（市民）
words.native_definition: a person who is not a member of the armed forces or police
words.core_concept: one who stands as a citizen, not under arms – 以市民身份而非武装身份在场的人
words.core_image: 街上穿便装的人流，中间夹着几个穿制服的
examples: Most of the casualties were civilians.
He returned to civilian life after the war.
semantic_expansions: 平民与老百姓：都是'以市民身份而非武装身份在场的人'，中文一个正式一个口语

words.root_logic: civil（市民的）+ -ize（使成为）→ 使之进入市民那套秩序 → 使文明
words.origin: 拉丁语 civilis（公民的）+ -ize
words.native_definition: to bring a group to a more organized and developed way of life
words.core_concept: bringing into the order citizens live by – 使之进入市民赖以相处的那套秩序
words.core_image: 野地上先划出街道，再立起规矩，人开始按序而居
examples: Rome sought to civilize the provinces.
Schooling helped civilize public debate.
semantic_expansions: 使文明与教化：都是'使之进入市民相处的那套秩序'，一个偏整体一个偏个人

words.root_logic: civilize（使入市民秩序）+ -ation（名词）→ 那套秩序连同其成果 → 文明
words.origin: 拉丁语 civilis（公民的）+ -ation
words.native_definition: an advanced stage of human society, or such a society itself
words.core_concept: the order citizens build and what it produces – 市民建起的那套秩序及其成果
words.core_image: 城墙、水渠、市集、法典摆在同一张图上
examples: The exhibition covers ancient civilizations.
Writing was crucial to early civilization.
semantic_expansions: 文明：市民秩序及其成果
文明社会：处在那套秩序中的社会。同一个词根，一个指成就一个指共同体

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ spond（应许）→ 把回应送回去 → 回应
words.origin: 拉丁语 respondere：re-（回）+ spondere（许诺）
words.native_definition: to say or do something in reply, or to react to a treatment
words.core_concept: giving something back in answer – 把回应送还给来问的一方
words.core_image: 球被打过来，人抬手把它打回去
examples: She responded within the hour.
The patient responded well to the drug.
semantic_expansions: 回应/答复：把回话送还给对方
有反应（对药物）：身体给出回应。同一个'把回应送回去'，一个是言语一个是生理

words.root_logic: respond（回应）+ -se（名词）→ 送回去的那份回应 → 反应
words.origin: 拉丁语 responsum：re-（回）+ spondere（许诺）
words.native_definition: an answer or reaction to something
words.core_concept: what is sent back as an answer – 被送回去的那份回应
words.core_image: 问卷收回来一叠，每张都是对同一问题的回话
examples: Her response was immediate.
The appeal drew a huge response.
semantic_expansions: 回答：送回来的那句话
反应/响应：送回来的那个动作或态度。同一个'被送回的回应'，形式不同

words.root_logic: respond（应许、答复）+ -ible（须…的）→ 出了事须给出回答的 → 负责的
words.recall_hint: respond（应许、答复）+ -ible → 出了事得由你出来给回答的；引申为靠得住、交得下事
words.origin: 拉丁语 responsabilis：respondere（回应、担保）
words.native_definition: having the duty to deal with something, or trustworthy and sensible
words.core_concept: bound to answer for it – 这件事得由你出来作答
words.core_image: 出了差错，被叫去说明情况的是签字那个人
examples: She is responsible for the whole team.
He is a responsible young man.
semantic_expansions: 负责的/有责任的：这件事须由你作答
可靠的：能把事交给他、他答得下来。同一个'须作答'，一个说义务一个说品性

words.root_logic: responsible（须作答的）+ -ity（名词）→ 须作答的那份分内之事 → 责任
words.origin: 拉丁语 respondere（回应、担保）
words.native_definition: a duty to deal with something, or blame for something that happened
words.core_concept: what one is bound to answer for – 须由自己作答的那一份
words.core_image: 分工表上每人名下一栏，出问题先看这一栏
examples: Safety is everyone's responsibility.
She took responsibility for the error.
semantic_expansions: 责任/职责：须由自己作答的那一份分内之事
担当：愿意把它认下来。同一个'须作答的份'，一个说范围一个说态度

words.root_logic: cor-（com- 的变体，相互）+ respond（回应）→ 两边互相应得上 → 相符；也指两人往来通信 → 通信
words.recall_hint: cor-（相互）+ respond（回应）→ 两边彼此应得上、对得上；也指两人一来一往地写信
words.origin: 拉丁语 correspondere：com-（一起）+ respondere（回应）
words.native_definition: to match or agree with something, or to exchange letters
words.core_concept: each answering to the other – 两边彼此应得上
words.core_image: 两份账目并排核对，每一行数字都对得上
examples: The figures do not correspond.
They corresponded for years before meeting.
semantic_expansions: 相符/对应：两边彼此应得上
通信：两人一来一往地相互回应。同一个'互相应答'，一个是状态一个是往来

words.root_logic: correspond（互相应上）+ -ence（名词）→ 互相应上的那种关系，或往来的信件 → 一致、信函
words.recall_hint: correspond（互相应上）+ -ence → 两边对得上的那种关系；也指一来一往积下的那些信
words.origin: 拉丁语 correspondere：com-（一起）+ respondere（回应）
words.native_definition: the letters exchanged between people, or a close similarity
words.core_concept: the state of answering each other – 彼此应得上的那种关系
words.core_image: 抽屉里按年份摞着的信，一封回一封
examples: Their correspondence fills three volumes.
There is a close correspondence between the two accounts.
semantic_expansions: 信函/通信：一来一往积下的那些信
一致：两边对得上的那种关系。同一个'互相应上'，一个是实物一个是关系

words.root_logic: correspond（往来回报）+ -ent（人）→ 从外地把消息回报回来的人 → 通讯员
words.origin: 拉丁语 correspondere：com-（一起）+ respondere（回应）
words.native_definition: a journalist who reports from a place, or someone who writes letters
words.core_concept: the one who writes back from where the news is – 在现场把消息回报回来的人
words.core_image: 画面右下角标着姓名与所在城市，人正对着镜头说
examples: Our correspondent in Cairo filed the report.
She was a lifelong correspondent of the poet.
semantic_expansions: 通讯员/驻外记者：从现场把消息回报回来的人
通信者：与人一来一往写信的人。同一个'往来回报'，一个对公众一个对私人

words.root_logic: spons（应许、担保）+ -or（人）→ 出面为某事作保的人 → 赞助者
words.origin: 拉丁语 sponsor：spondere（郑重许诺、担保）
words.native_definition: a person or firm that pays for an event, or one who supports a proposal
words.core_concept: the one who stands behind it with a pledge – 出面为它作保、把话应下来的人
words.core_image: 赛事横幅下方一排企业标志，出事由它们兜着
examples: The team found a new sponsor.
Two senators sponsored the bill.
semantic_expansions: 赞助者：拿钱为活动作保的人
保证人/发起人：把话应下来、为它站台的人。同一个'出面担保'，担的是钱还是名

words.root_logic: in-（里）+ ternal（属于那一侧的）→ 属于界线以内的 → 内部的
words.origin: 拉丁语 internus（里面的）← in-（在内）
words.native_definition: inside something, or within an organization or country
words.core_concept: belonging to the inner side of a boundary – 属于界线以内那一侧
words.core_image: 门关上以后，屋里的事外面听不见
examples: The report is for internal use only.
She suffered internal injuries.
semantic_expansions: 内部的（机构）/国内的（国家）：界线以内那一侧
体内的：身体这道界线以内。同一个'界内'，界线是门、国境还是皮肤

words.root_logic: ex-（外）+ ternal（属于那一侧的）→ 属于界线以外的 → 外部的
words.origin: 拉丁语 externus（外面的）← ex-（在外）
words.native_definition: outside something, or coming from outside a group
words.core_concept: belonging to the outer side of a boundary – 属于界线以外那一侧
words.core_image: 墙外面的雨打在窗上，屋里干着
examples: External factors affected the result.
The ointment is for external use.
semantic_expansions: 外部的/对外的：界线以外那一侧
外用的（药）：涂在体表而非吃进体内。同一个'界外'——与 internal 只差一个方位前缀

words.root_logic: inter-（之间）+ national（国家的）→ 在国与国之间的 → 国际的
words.origin: 拉丁语 inter-（之间）+ natio（国族）← nasci（出生）
words.native_definition: involving two or more countries
words.core_concept: in the space between nations – 处在国与国之间
words.core_image: 边境线两边各站一队人，谈的是横跨这条线的事
examples: The treaty set new international standards.
She works for an international charity.
semantic_expansions: 国际的与跨国的：都是'处在国与国之间'，中文按侧重分了两个词

words.root_logic: alter（另一个）+ -nate → 在这一个与另一个之间来回换 → 交替
words.origin: 拉丁语 alternare：alter（两者中的另一个）
words.native_definition: to happen or be used in turn, one after the other
words.core_concept: swapping between this one and the other – 在这个与另一个之间轮换
words.core_image: 红绿灯一个亮完换另一个，从不同时亮
examples: Wet days alternated with dry ones.
Plant them in alternate rows.
semantic_expansions: 交替/轮流：在两者之间来回换
隔一个的（形容词）：每隔一个取一个。同一个'两者轮换'，一个说过程一个说排布

words.root_logic: ap-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ pear（显现）→ 朝人眼前露出来 → 出现；引申为看上去像 → 显得
words.recall_hint: ap-（朝向）+ pear（显现）→ 朝人眼前露出来；引申为在人看来是那个样子
words.origin: 拉丁语 apparere：ad-（朝向）+ parere（露出）
words.native_definition: to become visible, or to seem to be a certain way
words.core_concept: coming into someone's view – 进入某人的视野
words.core_image: 雾散开，山的轮廓从白茫里浮出来
examples: A figure appeared at the door.
She appears tired today.
semantic_expansions: 出现/露面：进入别人的视野
显得：在别人看来是那个样子。同一个'呈现于视野'，一个是实体一个是印象

words.root_logic: appear（露出来）+ -ance（名词）→ 露面这件事，或露出来的那个样子 → 外观
words.recall_hint: appear（露出来）+ -ance → 露面这件事本身；也指露出来给人看到的那个样子
words.origin: 拉丁语 apparentia：apparere（显现）
words.native_definition: the way someone or something looks, or the act of coming into view
words.core_concept: the showing, or what is shown – 露面这件事，或所露出的那个样子
words.core_image: 台上一亮相，全场先看见的是那身打扮
examples: Do not judge by appearance.
This was her first public appearance.
semantic_expansions: 外观/外表：露出来给人看到的那个样子
露面：露出来这件事本身。同一个'呈现'，一个指所见一个指行为

words.root_logic: dis-（否定、去除）+ appear（露出）→ 不再露在眼前 → 消失
words.origin: 英语 dis- + appear，词根仍是拉丁语 apparere（显现）
words.native_definition: to stop being visible or to cease to exist
words.core_concept: passing out of view – 从视野里退出去
words.core_image: 船驶过地平线，桅杆最后一截也沉下去了
examples: The stain disappeared after washing.
He disappeared without a word.
semantic_expansions: 消失/不见：从视野里退出去
失踪（人）：人从众人视野里退出且找不到。同一个'退出视野'，程度和对象不同

words.root_logic: ap-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ peal（pel 的变体，推、呼）→ 朝某人推出请求 → 呼吁；引申为打动人 → 有吸引力
words.recall_hint: ap-（朝向）+ peal（推、呼）→ 朝某人推出请求；引申为某物朝人推来一股吸引力
words.origin: 拉丁语 appellare：ad-（朝向）+ pellere（推、驱动）
words.native_definition: to make an earnest request, to seek a higher court's review, or to attract
words.core_concept: pushing a request toward someone – 朝某人推出一份请求
words.core_image: 举着话筒面向人群请求帮助，声音一直推到最后一排
examples: The charity appealed for donations.
He appealed against the sentence.
The idea appeals to me.
semantic_expansions: 呼吁：朝众人推出请求
上诉：朝更高一级法院推出请求
有吸引力：某物朝人推来一股力，把人拉过去。三义共享'朝对方推出'

words.root_logic: nat（出生）+ -ion（名词）→ 因同出一源而聚成的那一群人 → 民族、国家
words.recall_hint: nat（出生）+ -ion → 因同出一源而聚成的那一群人；后来也指他们所据的那个国
words.origin: 拉丁语 natio：nasci（出生）——原意'同出一源的族群'
words.native_definition: a large group of people sharing a land, history, and government
words.core_concept: a people bound by common birth – 因同出一源而聚成的那群人
words.core_image: 同一片土地上的人说同一种话，祖上追得到一处
examples: The nation went to the polls in May.
Several nations signed the accord.
semantic_expansions: 民族：因同出一源而聚成的群
国家：这群人所据的那个政治实体。同一个'同源之群'，一个看血缘一个看疆域

words.root_logic: nation（同源之群）+ -al（…的）→ 属于整个国族的 → 全国的
words.origin: 拉丁语 natio（族群）+ -al
words.native_definition: relating to a whole country rather than a part of it
words.core_concept: belonging to the whole people – 属于整个国族，而非局部
words.core_image: 同一面旗挂在全国每个县城的门口
examples: It became a national holiday.
National income rose sharply.
semantic_expansions: 全国的/国家的：属于整个国族
国民（名词）：属于这个国族的人。同一个'属于整族'，一个说范围一个指人

words.root_logic: nat（出生）+ -ive（…的）→ 与出生地相关的 → 本地的、天生的
words.recall_hint: nat（出生）+ -ive → 与出生那一刻或那个地方相关的：或指原产于此，或指生来就会
words.origin: 拉丁语 nativus：nasci（出生）
words.native_definition: belonging to a place by birth, or possessed from birth
words.core_concept: belonging to one by birth – 由出生带来、不是后学的
words.core_image: 这片林子里原本就长着这种树，没人栽过
examples: She is a native speaker of Thai.
The plant is native to Japan.
semantic_expansions: 本地的：原产于此，不是移来的
母语的：出生就习得的那门语言
天生的：生来就有的。三义共享'由出生带来'

words.root_logic: nat（出生）+ -ure（名词）→ 生来就是那样的底子 → 天性；万物生来的那一整片 → 自然
words.recall_hint: nat（出生）+ -ure → 生来就是那样的底子；放大到万物，就是不经人手的那一整片
words.origin: 拉丁语 natura：nasci（出生）
words.native_definition: the physical world apart from people, or the basic character of someone or something
words.core_concept: how something is from birth – 生来就是那个样子
words.core_image: 没人打理的山谷，草木照自己的规矩长
examples: We spent the weekend out in nature.
It is not in her nature to complain.
semantic_expansions: 自然：万物生来的那一整片，不经人手
天性/本质：某人某物生来的那个底子。同一个'生来如此'，一个指外界一个指内在

words.root_logic: centrum（圆心）本身即词根，无词缀 → 定住不动、四周绕着它的那一点
words.recall_hint: centrum（圆心）本身即词根 → 定住不动、四周都绕着它的那一点；也指人事汇聚的那个地方
words.origin: 拉丁语 centrum（圆心）← 希腊语 kentron（圆规尖脚）
words.native_definition: the middle point of something, or a place where an activity is concentrated
words.core_concept: the point everything else is arranged around – 其余部分绕着它排布的那一点
words.core_image: 圆规扎住的那一点不动，笔尖绕着它走完一圈
examples: Draw a line through the centre.
She works at a research centre.
semantic_expansions: 中心/中央：几何上四周绕着的那一点
中心机构：人和事汇聚的那个地方。同一个'四周绕着它'，一个是点一个是场所

words.root_logic: centr（圆心）+ -al（…的）→ 处在中心的 → 中心的；引申为最要紧的 → 核心的
words.recall_hint: centr（圆心）+ -al → 处在那一点上的；引申为整件事都绕着它转，因而最要紧
words.origin: 拉丁语 centralis：centrum（圆心）
words.native_definition: in the middle, or most important
words.core_concept: sitting at the point others turn around – 位于其余部分环绕的那一点
words.core_image: 地图上那条街正在城中间，各条路都通向它
examples: The hotel has a central location.
Trust is central to the argument.
semantic_expansions: 中心的/中央的：位置上处在中间
核心的：整件事都绕着它转，因而最要紧。同一个'居中'，一个说位置一个说分量

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ centr（中心）+ -ate → 全往一个中心聚 → 集中；心思全聚到一点 → 专心
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ centr（中心）+ -ate → 全都往同一个中心聚过去：可以是物，也可以是心思
words.origin: 拉丁语 com-（一起）+ centrum（圆心）
words.native_definition: to bring things together in one place, or to focus one's attention
words.core_concept: gathering everything to one point – 把散着的全聚到一点上
words.core_image: 放大镜把满片阳光收成一个亮点，纸开始冒烟
examples: Industry is concentrated in the south.
I cannot concentrate with the noise.
semantic_expansions: 集中：把散着的物聚到一处
专心：把心思聚到一点
浓缩：把成分聚到更小体积里。三义共享'全聚到一个中心'

words.root_logic: concentrate（聚到一点）+ -ion（名词）→ 聚到一点这件事，或聚拢的程度 → 集中、浓度
words.recall_hint: concentrate（全聚到一点）+ -ion → 聚拢这件事本身，或聚得有多密
words.origin: 拉丁语 com-（一起）+ centrum（圆心）
words.native_definition: the act of focusing attention, or the amount of a substance in a mixture
words.core_concept: how much has been gathered to one point – 往一点聚拢的那个程度
words.core_image: 同样一杯水里糖越多越甜，聚得越密味道越重
examples: The task demands full concentration.
Salt concentration rises as water evaporates.
semantic_expansions: 专注/集中：心思或事物聚拢这件事
浓度：物质在单位体积里聚得多密。同一个'聚拢的程度'，量的是注意力还是成分

words.root_logic: ident（同一个）+ -ity（名词）→ 是同一个而非另一个的那件事 → 身份
words.recall_hint: ident（就是那一个）+ -ity → 确认是同一个而非另一个的那件事；也指一个人自认为是谁
words.origin: 拉丁语 identitas：idem（同一个）
words.native_definition: who or what someone or something is
words.core_concept: being the very same one, not another – 是这一个而非另一个
words.core_image: 照片、指纹、签名三样对上，确认是本人
examples: Police confirmed the victim's identity.
The town has kept its own identity.
semantic_expansions: 身份：确认是这一个人而非另一个
同一性/特征：使它区别于其他的那个'就是它'。同一个'是同一个'，一个对人一个对物

words.root_logic: ident（同一个）+ -ical（…的）→ 像是同一个的 → 完全相同的
words.origin: 拉丁语 identicus：idem（同一个）
words.native_definition: exactly the same in every detail
words.core_concept: so alike as to be the same one – 相似到像是同一个
words.core_image: 两张卡片叠在一起对光，边线笔画完全重合
examples: The twins are identical.
The two reports are identical.
semantic_expansions: 完全相同的与同一的：都是'相似到像是同一个'，中文一个偏比较一个偏判定

words.root_logic: ident（同一个）+ -ify（使成为）→ 认定它与那一个为同一 → 辨认
words.origin: 拉丁语 idem（同一个）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: to recognize who or what something is, or to feel connected with someone
words.core_concept: establishing that this is the very one – 认定它就是那一个
words.core_image: 在一排面孔里指出那一个：就是他
examples: She identified the man in the lineup.
Readers identify with the narrator.
semantic_expansions: 辨认/确定：认定它就是那一个
认同（identify with）：把对方当成与自己同一类。同一个'认定为同一'，一个对外一个对己

words.root_logic: identify（认定为同一）+ -ation（名词）→ 认定这件事，或据以认定的那份证件 → 识别、身份证明
words.recall_hint: identify（认定是那一个）+ -ation → 认定这件事本身；也指用来作此认定的那份证件
words.origin: 拉丁语 idem（同一个）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: the act of recognizing something, or a document proving who you are
words.core_concept: the establishing of which one it is – 认定它是哪一个这件事
words.core_image: 窗口要求出示证件，照片与本人比对一遍
examples: Identification of the species took months.
Please bring photo identification.
semantic_expansions: 识别/鉴定：认定它是哪一个这件事
身份证明：用来作此认定的那份文件。同一个'认定同一'，一个是行为一个是凭据

words.root_logic: dur（硬、持续）+ -able（能…的）→ 能一直撑下去的 → 耐用的
words.origin: 拉丁语 durabilis：durare（持续）← durus（硬的）
words.native_definition: able to last a long time without breaking
words.core_concept: able to keep holding up over time – 能一直硬撑着不坏
words.core_image: 同一把锄头用了三十年，木柄换过铁头还在
examples: Choose a durable fabric for chairs.
They reached a durable settlement.
semantic_expansions: 耐用的与持久的：都是'能一直硬撑着不坏'，中文按对象是物还是状态分了两个词

words.root_logic: dur（持续）+ -ation（名词）→ 撑下去的那一段长度 → 持续时间
words.origin: 拉丁语 duratio：durare（持续）
words.native_definition: the length of time something continues
words.core_concept: how long something keeps going – 一件事撑下去的那段长度
words.core_image: 秒表从按下到按停，中间那一段就是它
examples: The duration of the flight is six hours.
Stay seated for the duration of the talk.
semantic_expansions: 持续时间与期间：都是'撑下去的那一段长度'，中文一个说量一个说范围

words.root_logic: dur（持续）+ -ing（进行中）→ 在某事持续的那段时间里 → 在…期间
words.origin: 拉丁语 durare（持续）的现在分词形式，经中古英语固定为介词
words.native_definition: throughout the time that something continues
words.core_concept: within the stretch while something lasts – 在某事撑着的那一段之内
words.core_image: 会议从头到尾这段时间里，手机一直静音
examples: It rained during the night.
She fell asleep during the film.
semantic_expansions: 在…期间与在…过程中：都是'在某事撑着的那一段之内'，中文按侧重时间还是过程分了两个词

words.root_logic: en-（使…）+ dur（硬撑）+ -ance（名词）→ 硬撑下去的那份能力 → 耐力
words.origin: 拉丁语 indurare：in-（使…）+ durare（持续、变硬）
words.native_definition: the ability to keep going through difficulty or pain
words.core_concept: the capacity to keep holding under strain – 在压力下硬撑下去的那份能力
words.core_image: 长跑最后几公里，腿已经不听话但人还在往前迈
examples: The race is a test of endurance.
Her endurance surprised everyone.
semantic_expansions: 耐力/持久力：身体硬撑下去的能力
忍耐力：心上硬撑下去的能力。同一个'撑得住'，撑的是体力还是心力

words.root_logic: dom（家、屋）+ -estic（…的）→ 属于家里的 → 家庭的；一国之内视同一家 → 国内的
words.recall_hint: dom（家、屋）+ -estic → 属于家里那一摊的；把一国看成一家，就是国内的
words.origin: 拉丁语 domesticus：domus（家、房屋）
words.native_definition: relating to the home or family, or within one country
words.core_concept: belonging to the household – 属于自家门内那一摊
words.core_image: 门一关，屋里的事归屋里管
examples: She shares the domestic chores.
Domestic flights leave from Terminal 1.
semantic_expansions: 家庭的：属于自家门内那一摊
国内的：把一国看成一家，界内之事
家养的（动物）：进了家门被养起来的。三义共享'属于门内'

words.root_logic: domin（主人）+ -ate（动词）→ 像主人那样压住全场 → 支配
words.origin: 拉丁语 dominari：dominus（主人）← domus（家）
words.native_definition: to have control over something, or to be the most noticeable part of it
words.core_concept: holding sway as the master does – 像主人那样把全场压住
words.core_image: 一栋高楼立在街口，走到哪儿抬头都是它
examples: One firm dominates the market.
The castle dominates the skyline.
semantic_expansions: 支配/统治：像主人那样掌控
占主导（视觉上）：把周围都压住、最先被看见。同一个'主人般压住全场'，压的是权力还是视线

words.root_logic: dominate（压住全场）+ -ant（…的）→ 压住其余的 → 占主导的
words.origin: 拉丁语 dominans：dominari（做主）← dominus（主人）
words.native_definition: most important, powerful, or noticeable
words.core_concept: standing over the rest – 压在其余之上的那一个
words.core_image: 几种颜色里那一片红最抢眼，其余都退成背景
examples: English is the dominant language here.
Brown eyes are a dominant trait.
semantic_expansions: 占主导的/支配的：压在其余之上
显性的（遗传）：表现出来盖过另一个的那个。同一个'压住其余'，一个在势力一个在性状

words.root_logic: cura（照料）本身即词根，无词缀 → 照料到病好为止
words.recall_hint: cura（照料）本身即词根 → 照料到病好为止；名词则是使人好起来的那个办法
words.origin: 拉丁语 cura（照料）→ curare（照料、治疗）
words.native_definition: to make an illness or problem go away, or a remedy that does so
words.core_concept: tending something until it is well – 一直照料到它好了
words.core_image: 药一天天喂下去，烧终于退了
examples: The drug cured her infection.
There is no easy cure for inflation.
semantic_expansions: 治愈/疗法：照料到病好
解决（问题）：照料到麻烦消掉。同一个'照料到好'，对象是病还是事

words.root_logic: cur（关切）+ -ious（…的）→ 心思一直放在某事上想弄清 → 好奇的；引申为反常到引人留意 → 奇怪的
words.recall_hint: cur（关切）+ -ious → 心思一直搁在某事上想弄清；反过来说，某物反常到让人搁不下时也用它
words.origin: 拉丁语 curiosus：cura（关切）
words.native_definition: eager to know something, or strange and hard to explain
words.core_concept: with attention fixed on something – 心思一直搁在那件事上
words.core_image: 小孩趴在玻璃前不肯走，一定要看清里面是什么
examples: She was curious about his past.
A curious smell came from the cellar.
semantic_expansions: 好奇的：心思搁在某事上想弄清
奇怪的：反常到让人搁不下心思。同一个'牵住注意力'，一个是主动想知一个是被动被吸引

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ cur（关切）+ -ate → 用足了心思做出来的 → 精确的
words.origin: 拉丁语 accuratus：ad-（朝向）+ cura（关切）——'费过心的'
words.native_definition: correct in every detail, without error
words.core_concept: done with care taken over every part – 每一处都费过心，因而不差
words.core_image: 抄录的人逐字核对了三遍，一个数字都没错
examples: The forecast proved accurate.
We need accurate figures before deciding.
semantic_expansions: 精确的与准确的：都是'每处都费过心因而不差'，中文一个偏数值一个偏结论

words.root_logic: se-（脱离）+ cure（关切、忧心）→ 脱离了牵挂、不必再操心的 → 安全的
words.recall_hint: se-（脱离）+ cure（忧心）→ 不必再操心了；作动词则是把某物弄到不必操心的状态
words.origin: 拉丁语 securus：se-（脱离）+ cura（忧心）——'无忧的'
words.native_definition: safe from harm or loss, or to obtain something and make it safe
words.core_concept: free from having to worry – 已经脱离了要操心的状态
words.core_image: 门锁上、窗关好，睡前不用再起来查一遍
examples: The building is secure at night.
She secured a place at the college.
semantic_expansions: 安全的/牢固的：不必再操心它会出事
获得（动词）：把某物弄到手并弄稳。同一个'脱离忧心'，一个是状态一个是使之达到该状态

words.root_logic: secure（无须操心的）+ -ity（名词）→ 不必操心的那个状态或保障 → 安全
words.recall_hint: secure（不必操心的）+ -ity → 不必操心的那个状态；也指用来让人不必操心的那份保障或人手
words.origin: 拉丁语 securitas：se-（脱离）+ cura（忧心）
words.native_definition: the state of being safe, or measures taken to stay safe
words.core_concept: the state of not needing to worry – 不必再操心的那个状态
words.core_image: 门口站着的人一直在看，所以里面的人不用回头
examples: Airport security has been tightened.
A pension gives some financial security.
semantic_expansions: 安全：不必操心的那个状态
保障：使人不必操心的那份依托
保安：负责让人不必操心的那些人。三义共享'脱离忧心'

words.root_logic: cred（相信、托付）+ -it → 别人肯把东西先交给你的那份信任 → 信用；引申为该记在谁名下的功劳 → 归功
words.recall_hint: cred（相信、托付）+ -it → 别人肯先把东西交给你的那份信任；也指该记在谁名下的那份功劳
words.origin: 拉丁语 creditum：credere（相信、托付）——'被托付之物'
words.native_definition: trust that allows delayed payment, praise for an achievement, or an entry of money received
words.core_concept: what is entrusted to someone on trust – 因信任而先交到你手上的那一份
words.core_image: 东西先拿走，账记在名下，月底再结
examples: She bought the car on credit.
He deserves credit for the idea.
The course is worth four credits.
semantic_expansions: 信用/赊账：别人肯先把东西交给你
功劳：该记在你名下的那一份
学分：记在你名下的修课凭据。四义共享'记在某人名下、基于信任'

words.root_logic: cred（相信）+ -ible（可…的）→ 可以相信的 → 可信的
words.origin: 拉丁语 credibilis：credere（相信）
words.native_definition: able to be believed or trusted
words.core_concept: such that one can believe it – 可以放心相信的
words.core_image: 三方说法互相对得上，这个版本站得住
examples: The witness gave a credible account.
They lack a credible plan.
semantic_expansions: 可信的与可靠的：都是'可以放心相信'，一个偏说法一个偏人或方案

words.root_logic: in-（否定）+ cred（相信）+ -ible → 没法相信的 → 难以置信的
words.origin: 拉丁语 incredibilis：in-（不）+ credere（相信）
words.native_definition: too extraordinary to be believed, or extremely good
words.core_concept: beyond what one can believe – 超出能相信的范围
words.core_image: 听完只想再问一遍：真是这样？
examples: The story sounds incredible.
She did an incredible job.
semantic_expansions: 难以置信的：超出能相信的范围
极好的：好到让人不敢信。同一个'信不过来'，一个是怀疑一个是赞叹

words.root_logic: credible（可信的）+ -ity（名词）→ 值得被相信的那个程度 → 可信度
words.origin: 拉丁语 credibilis（可信的）← credere（相信）
words.native_definition: the quality of being believed or trusted
words.core_concept: how far one can be believed – 值得被相信到什么程度
words.core_image: 过去说过的话都兑现了，这次说的也就有人听
examples: The scandal damaged his credibility.
The report lends credibility to the claim.
semantic_expansions: 可信度与公信力：都是'值得被相信的程度'，一个对个人一个对机构

words.root_logic: grat（讨喜、恩惠）本身即词根，无词缀 → 白给的好意，或看着讨喜的那份从容
words.recall_hint: grat（讨喜、恩惠）本身即词根 → 白给的那份好意；也指举止看着讨喜的那种从容
words.origin: 拉丁语 gratia（恩惠、讨喜）← gratus（受欢迎的）
words.native_definition: smooth elegance of movement, or favour freely given
words.core_concept: something pleasing that is freely given – 白白给出的那份讨喜
words.core_image: 舞者转身时没有一处使劲的痕迹，看着毫不费力
examples: She moved with great grace.
They were given three days' grace to pay.
semantic_expansions: 优雅：举止讨喜、不见吃力
恩惠/宽限：白给的那份好意。同一个'讨喜而白给'，一个在举止一个在待人

words.root_logic: grace（讨喜的从容）+ -ful（充满…的）→ 处处见从容的 → 优雅的
words.origin: 拉丁语 gratia（讨喜）+ 英语 -ful
words.native_definition: moving or shaped in a smooth and attractive way
words.core_concept: full of ease that pleases the eye – 通身是那种看着舒服的从容
words.core_image: 鹤落地时翅膀慢慢收拢，没有一下是急的
examples: She made a graceful exit.
The bridge has a graceful curve.
semantic_expansions: 优雅的：举止通身从容
得体的（退场）：处理得让人无从指摘。同一个'见从容'，一个说姿态一个说分寸

words.root_logic: grac（恩惠）+ -ious（…的）→ 惯于给人好意的 → 亲切的
words.origin: 拉丁语 gratiosus：gratia（恩惠）
words.native_definition: kind and polite, especially to those of lower rank
words.core_concept: ready to grant favour to others – 惯于把好意给出去
words.core_image: 主人亲自把客人送到门口，还替他挡了下风
examples: She was gracious in defeat.
Thank you for your gracious hospitality.
semantic_expansions: 亲切的/宽厚的：惯于把好意给出去
优美的（居所）：处处见体贴与从容。同一个'施予讨喜'，一个对人一个对物

words.root_logic: dis-（去除）+ grace（讨喜、体面）→ 讨喜和体面全没了 → 耻辱
words.origin: 拉丁语 dis-（去除）+ gratia（讨喜、恩宠）
words.native_definition: loss of respect because of bad behaviour, or someone causing such loss
words.core_concept: having lost all favour – 好意与体面被剥掉之后的状态
words.core_image: 从前替他说话的人现在都不出声了
examples: He resigned in disgrace.
Their treatment of workers is a disgrace.
semantic_expansions: 耻辱/丢脸：体面被剥掉后的状态
败坏名声（动词）：使人失去体面。同一个'讨喜尽失'，一个是结果一个是致因

words.root_logic: grat（受了恩惠）+ -ful（充满…的）→ 心里记着那份好意的 → 感激的
words.origin: 拉丁语 gratus（受欢迎的、心怀感谢的）+ 英语 -ful
words.native_definition: feeling thankful for something someone has done
words.core_concept: holding on to a favour received – 心里存着受过的那份好意
words.core_image: 对方帮完就走了，这边一直记着这件事
examples: I am grateful for your help.
She wrote a grateful note.
semantic_expansions: 感激的与感谢的：都是'心里存着受过的好意'，中文按程度分了两个词

words.root_logic: ap-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ preci（价值）+ -ate → 看出它值多少 → 赏识；引申为价值往上走 → 增值
words.recall_hint: ap-（朝向）+ preci（价值）+ -ate → 看出它值多少：可以是欣赏，也可以是道谢，也可以是价格自己往上走
words.origin: 拉丁语 appretiare：ad-（朝向）+ pretium（价格、价值）
words.native_definition: to recognize the value of something, to be thankful, or to rise in value
words.core_concept: seeing what something is worth – 看出它的分量与价值
words.core_image: 行家拿起那只碗翻看底款，说出它值多少
examples: I appreciate your patience.
The house has appreciated since 2020.
semantic_expansions: 赏识：看出它的价值
感谢：看出对方所做的分量
增值：价值本身往上走。三义共享'认到价值'，一个看物一个看情一个看价

words.root_logic: preci（价值、价格）+ -ous（…的）→ 值大价钱的 → 珍贵的
words.origin: 拉丁语 pretiosus：pretium（价格、价值）
words.native_definition: of great value, or much loved
words.core_concept: carrying a high worth – 分量重、值大价钱
words.core_image: 小盒子用绒布垫着，取的时候两只手一起捧
examples: Water is precious in the desert.
These letters are precious to her.
semantic_expansions: 珍贵的与宝贵的：都是'分量重、值大价钱'，中文一个偏物一个可偏情

words.root_logic: pretium（价格）本身即词根，无词缀 → 换取它所要付出的那个数
words.origin: 拉丁语 pretium（价格、代价）经古法语 pris 进入英语
words.native_definition: the amount of money needed to buy something, or what must be given up
words.core_concept: what must be handed over to get it – 要拿到它必须付出的那一份
words.core_image: 标签上那个数字，付了才能把东西拿走
examples: The price has doubled since spring.
He won, but at a heavy price.
semantic_expansions: 价格：换取它要付的钱数
代价：换取它要付出的其他东西。同一个'必须交出的那一份'，付的是钱还是别的

words.root_logic: sentire（感觉）本身即词根，无词缀 → 感受这件事，以及由此得出的判断
words.recall_hint: sentire（感觉）本身即词根 → 感受这件事本身；引申为由感受得出的判断力，或一段话说得通的那个意思
words.origin: 拉丁语 sensus：sentire（感觉）
words.native_definition: any of the faculties of perception, good judgement, or the meaning of something
words.core_concept: what one perceives, and what one makes of it – 感到什么，以及由此判定什么
words.core_image: 手伸进水里先感到凉，接着判断这水不能洗手
examples: She lost her sense of smell.
He had the sense to stop early.
That sentence makes no sense.
semantic_expansions: 感觉：感官所感到的
判断力：由感受得出的分辨能力
意义：一段话能被感知、说得通的那个内容。三义共享'感到并由此明白'

words.root_logic: sens（感觉、判断）+ -ible（能…的）→ 能凭感受作出判断的 → 明智的
words.origin: 拉丁语 sensibilis：sentire（感觉）
words.native_definition: showing good judgement; practical rather than emotional
words.core_concept: guided by sound perception – 凭得住的感受与判断行事
words.core_image: 下雨前先带伞的人，不必等淋了才想起来
examples: That is a sensible precaution.
Wear sensible shoes for the hike.
semantic_expansions: 明智的/合情理的：判断凭得住
切合实际的（鞋）：以实用而非好看为准。同一个'凭感受与判断行事'，一个说人一个说物

words.root_logic: sens（感觉）+ -ation（名词）→ 被感到的那一下；引申为让所有人都感到的那件事 → 轰动
words.recall_hint: sens（感觉）+ -ation → 身上被感到的那一下；放大到人群，就是让所有人都感到的那件事
words.origin: 拉丁语 sensatio：sentire（感觉）
words.native_definition: a physical feeling, or great excitement among many people
words.core_concept: something felt, whether in the body or by a crowd – 被感到的那一下，落在身上或人群里
words.core_image: 指尖麻了一下；消息传开时整条街都在议论
examples: A burning sensation spread up his arm.
Her debut caused a sensation.
semantic_expansions: 感觉/知觉：身上被感到的那一下
轰动：让整群人同时感到的那件事。同一个'被感到'，范围从一人到一群

words.root_logic: sent（感觉、判定）+ -ence（名词）→ 表达一个完整判断的那串话 → 句子；法官作出的判定 → 判决
words.recall_hint: sent（感觉、判定）+ -ence → 承载一个完整判断的那串话；在法庭上则是法官作出的那个判定
words.origin: 拉丁语 sententia：sentire（感觉、判断）——'所持的意见'
words.native_definition: a group of words expressing a complete thought, or a punishment decided by a court
words.core_concept: a completed judgement put into words – 被说成话的一个完整判断
words.core_image: 写满一行字后落下句号，意思到此完整了
examples: Read the second sentence again.
He received a five-year sentence.
semantic_expansions: 句子：承载一个完整判断的那串话
判决/宣判：法官所作的那个判定。同一个'成形的判断'，一个在语言一个在法庭

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ sent（感觉、想）→ 双方所感相同 → 同意
words.origin: 拉丁语 consentire：com-（一起）+ sentire（感觉）——'同感'
words.native_definition: permission or agreement for something to happen
words.core_concept: feeling the same way as the other – 与对方所感一致
words.core_image: 两人对看一眼同时点头，不必再说什么
examples: The patient gave written consent.
She consented to the interview.
semantic_expansions: 同意/赞同：与对方所感一致
许可：因所感一致而放行。同一个'同感'，一个是态度一个是授权

words.root_logic: re-（回、随之）+ sult（跳）→ 事情之后蹦出来的那个 → 结果
words.origin: 拉丁语 resultare：re-（回）+ salire（跳）——'反弹回来'
words.native_definition: something that happens because of an action or event
words.core_concept: what leaps back out of what was done – 做完之后蹦出来的那个东西
words.core_image: 球砸在墙上，弹回来的那一下就是它
examples: The result was announced at noon.
Careless work results in errors.
semantic_expansions: 结果/成绩：事后蹦出来的那个
导致（动词）：使那个东西蹦出来。同一个'随之弹出'，一个是所得一个是致因

words.root_logic: in-（朝…上）+ sult（跳）→ 跳到别人身上去踩 → 侮辱
words.origin: 拉丁语 insultare：in-（朝上）+ salire（跳）——'跳到人身上'
words.native_definition: to say or do something offensive to someone
words.core_concept: leaping onto someone to trample them – 跳到对方身上去踩
words.core_image: 对方已经跌倒了，还上去踩一脚
examples: He insulted her in front of everyone.
The remark was a deliberate insult.
semantic_expansions: 侮辱/辱骂/冒犯：都是'跳到人身上去踩'，中文按方式与轻重分了三个词

words.root_logic: consulere（商议）本身即词根，无额外前缀 → 把事拿去请人给个说法
words.recall_hint: consulere（商议、求教）本身即词根 → 把事拿去请人给个说法；也用于查阅资料，向书求教
words.origin: 拉丁语 consultare：consulere（商议、求教）的反复形
words.native_definition: to ask someone for advice or information, or to look something up
words.core_concept: taking a matter to someone for their view – 把事拿去请对方给个说法
words.core_image: 拿着病历坐到医生对面，等他说该怎么办
examples: You should consult a lawyer first.
She consulted the timetable again.
semantic_expansions: 咨询/请教：拿事去请人给说法
查阅（资料）：拿事去向书本求答案。同一个'求个说法'，求于人还是于书

words.root_logic: consult（请人给说法）+ -ant（人）→ 专供人请教的那个人 → 顾问
words.origin: 拉丁语 consultare（商议）+ -ant
words.native_definition: an expert who gives professional advice, or a senior hospital doctor
words.core_concept: the one people bring matters to – 专门被拿事去请教的那个人
words.core_image: 会议室里那个不属于本公司的人，专门被请来给意见
examples: They hired a tax consultant.
The consultant will see you now.
semantic_expansions: 顾问/咨询师：专供人请教的人
主任医师（英式）：科室里被请去定夺的那位。同一个'被请教者'，行业不同

words.root_logic: sect（切）+ -or（物）→ 被切出来的那一块 → 部门、扇形
words.recall_hint: sect（切）+ -or → 从整体上切出来的那一块：可以是经济中的一块，也可以是圆里的一瓣
words.origin: 拉丁语 sector：secare（切）
words.native_definition: a part of an economy or society, or a part of a circle between two radii
words.core_concept: a piece cut out of a whole – 从整体上切下来的那一块
words.core_image: 圆饼从圆心切两刀，取出中间那一瓣
examples: The public sector employs millions.
Shade the sector between the two radii.
semantic_expansions: 部门/行业：从整体经济上切出的一块
扇形：从圆上切出的一瓣。同一个'切出的一块'，切的是社会还是圆

words.root_logic: sect（切）+ -ion（名词）→ 切开所得的那一段，或切开这件事 → 部分、剖面
words.recall_hint: sect（切）+ -ion → 切开所得的那一段；也指把东西切开看到的那个面
words.origin: 拉丁语 sectio：secare（切）
words.native_definition: one of the parts something is divided into, or a view of something cut through
words.core_concept: what a cut produces – 切开之后所得的那一段或那个面
words.core_image: 树干横锯一刀，年轮全露在切面上
examples: Read the final section carefully.
The diagram shows a cross section.
semantic_expansions: 部分/章节：切开所得的那一段
剖面：切开后露出的那个面。同一个'切'，一个看段落一个看断面

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ sect（切）→ 身上像被切出几道口子的那种动物 → 昆虫
words.origin: 拉丁语 insectum：in-（进入）+ secare（切）——'身体有切痕的'
words.native_definition: a small animal with six legs and a body divided into three parts
words.core_concept: a creature whose body looks cut into segments – 身体像被切成几节的那种小动物
words.core_image: 蚂蚁的腰细成一线，前后像是两截接起来的
examples: Bees are social insects.
The garden is full of insects in June.

words.root_logic: inter-（之间、互相）+ sect（切）+ -ion → 两者互切所得的那一点 → 交叉口
words.origin: 拉丁语 intersectio：inter-（之间）+ secare（切）
words.native_definition: a place where two roads or lines cross
words.core_concept: where two things cut across each other – 两者互相切过的那一处
words.core_image: 两条路交叉的那个方块，四个方向都通
examples: Turn left at the next intersection.
The intersection of the two sets is empty.
semantic_expansions: 交叉口/十字路口：两条路互切的那一处
交集（数学）：两个集合互切所得的部分。同一个'互相切过'，切的是路还是集合

words.root_logic: seg（sec 的变体，切）+ -ment（结果）→ 被切下来的那一节 → 部分
words.origin: 拉丁语 segmentum：secare（切）
words.native_definition: one of the parts into which something is divided
words.core_concept: one piece cut off the whole – 从整体上切下来的一节
words.core_image: 橘子剥开，一瓣一瓣界限分明
examples: Divide the line into three segments.
This segment of the market is growing.
semantic_expansions: 部分/节：从整体上切下的一段
瓣（果实）：天然分界的那一节。同一个'切下的一节'，人为切还是天生分

words.root_logic: re-（反过来）+ sent（感觉）→ 心里对某事生出反感 → 怨恨
words.origin: 拉丁语 re-（反）+ sentire（感觉）经法语 ressentir
words.native_definition: to feel bitter about something you think is unfair
words.core_concept: feeling back against something – 心里朝那件事生出反感
words.core_image: 话早过去了，一想起来胸口还是堵
examples: She resented being left out.
He resents any criticism.
semantic_expansions: 怨恨/愤恨/不满：都是'心里朝那件事生出反感'，中文按强度分了三个词
